Comments (English): [ Worked until it didn't ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher 3 years ago. Aside from the cycle in which the dishes get completely dry takes 3 hours, we liked it and its features. We like the removable third rack (which we use almost every time), adjustable top rack and adjustable tines. It was pretty quiet. The top plastic on the control panel started lifting from the heat and steam but it still worked. Then one day it wouldn't let us start a cycle, it wouldn't do anything. Diagnostic didn't work. After examining the machine, replacing the control panel, and the door latch, we have no choice but to give up and replace it since having a technician come out would be more expensive than buying a new one. Super disappointed that we splurged on a washer with the features we like but only lasted 3 years.

I then had to purchase an electrical box, plug, and faceplate and complete the installation myself. One of the home depot staff told me that the installers weren't electricians. Guess who else isn't an electrician? After I connected the ground wire, I had a 50/50 chance with the hot and neutral wires, and I managed to get it right because I checked the polarity with a polarity checker. It would have been nice to know up front, that they could not do the installation.

Sentence (English): I loved my old KitchenAid dishwasher which I had for 16 years.
Comments (English): [ Learning curve with this dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I loved my old KitchenAid dishwasher which I had for 16 years. I honestly couldn't find anything I thought I would like as well. I finally decided to go with this dishwasher although I was skeptical about several things. I will say that I am starting to like it more than I did at first. First of all it is extremely quiet. You can't tell it's running except for the light that shines on the floor to show you it is on. So far my dishes have come clean without fail. That being said I am rinsing my dishes more than ever before putting them in the dishwasher. My old dishwasher had a built in grinder and did not have a filter that needed cleaned. Just watch some of the You Tube videos of real people cleaning their filters and you will not want food getting stuck in the filter, or worse bypassing the filter through the opening in the top portion of the filter which could allow pieces of food to bypass the filter completely. The filter is somewhat difficult to remove as the bottom spray arm is in the way. Instructions say to remove the bottom spray arm but even my husband couldn't pull it out. We had to move it manually and it did not want to spin. I feel this could damage something and I worry about that. I wish you could just easily remove the filter for cleaning without all these worries. With my old KitchenAid there were no filters to mess with. When you do remove this filter there is water sitting in the bottom of the dishwasher. This is supposed to be normal but I have not experienced this in any other dishwasher I have owned. It is also easy to hit buttons by accident since they are on the top of the door. I have used the crystal dry feature and my dishes have been completely dry which concerned me since there is no heating element used during the dry cycle. I also didn't think that I would like that this only came with a small silverware holder but I have come to embrace the third rack for silverware. I do wish the silverware holder was toward the front of the machine so you could just open it partially to add one piece of silverware. I personally do not want any of my appliances to be connected to Wifi but some features can only be used with Wifi for this dishwasher. I will never be using the features because I was unable to connect. I don't plan to spend hours on end trying to troubleshoot this to only have to do it again and again. I have had to learn some different methods to load this dishwasher but have figured out a system now. Some things are easier to load than before and some are harder. I do like the feature for securing wine glasses on the top rack. It is also nice that you can place plastics on the lower rack since there is no heating element used for the drying cycle. There is a strange smell to this dishwasher when you open the door after a cycle. I have noticed this smell on some of the plastic items. I'm not sure if this is from the crystal dry or what causes the odor. Others have mentioned the odor as well. I would like to know how to eliminate that. This dishwasher looks nice in my kitchen and I am liking it more each day. I paid for installation which it through a third party and they did a great job and I was very happy with their service.

However, I hesitated to install a dishwasher due to my small kitchen, until I discovered the compact Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person. Improved Quality of Life: Above all, I love that I can spend less time washing dishes, so I can do other things or relax during that time. Limited Capacity: As the name suggests, this is a mini dishwasher, so it's difficult to wash large quantities at once. Unlike a regular household dishwasher, it might not be enough to handle the entire family's dishes at once. However, since I originally purchased it for baby dishes and light dishwashing, this didn't seem like a major drawback. 2. Noise: It's not completely noiseless. While this might be acceptable for those with a large kitchen or a large home, those with a kitchen close to the bedroom or a smaller home should be mindful of the noise. Overall Review: The Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-Person is an efficient appliance that can be used without burden even in a small kitchen. Despite its compact size, it offers a variety of washing and drying functions, making it perfect for keeping baby's dishes and frequently used dishes clean. While it can't handle as many loads as a full-size dishwasher, frequent runs of small loads are more than enough. My wife and I, who used to stress about hand-washing dishes every day, are enjoying the convenience, and our quality of life has definitely improved. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for an efficient dishwasher, even in a small kitchen! If my review helped you decide to purchase, please click the "Helpful" button. Thank you!

They say the warranty covers up to two years, but why do products always break down right after the warranty expires? We didn't want to touch the sink, and since we live in a three-person household, we didn't have a lot of dishes, and we didn't know how effective the dishwasher would be, so we chose a six-person dishwasher. We bought this product based on the formula that LG is the best for home appliances. It's a bit more expensive than other brands, but we were able to buy it for our aunt at a low price by using gift certificates and other things we had. :) It arrived 2-3 days after we purchased it, and we coordinated with the technician to install it and give him a detailed explanation so that we could use it right away. There was a hole in the top plate where the water purifier was installed, so I asked if it could be connected there, but they said it wasn't possible, so we decided to make a separate hole, but the hole diameter was bigger than I thought, so I was a little surprised. It's the only one among the six-person dishes that has a two-tier configuration, so it seems easy to clean. The top shelf can be removed, and the height can be adjusted to two levels, so I think you can use it freely as needed. There is no automatic door opening function, but I just turn it over and wash it, and it's done when I come out, so I just open the door and let it dry naturally. So I don't feel any major inconvenience. However, this is my fault for not looking for reviews and buying it, but the interior material is not all stainless steel. Maybe because the ceiling is plastic, even when I use the drying function, water droplets form, and the water droplets gather in the concave part of the bowl and frequently wet the floor every time I take it out. The tray is not coated, so it seems like there is a high risk of fine scratches, but I don't take care of the bowl and just use it, so I'm a little worried, but that's about it. Since I have a child, I use a dishwasher detergent with good ingredients, Po* powder detergent. I used to put in 5g at a time, but it seemed like there were too many water marks and it didn't clean well, so I put in 10g and it was very clean + clean. If you are thinking of using the same detergent as me, please take note! I don't know when that will happen, but if I move or the number of households increases, I think I will buy the 12-person version again.

Sentence (English): Our Bosch dishwasher was installed on January 21, 2025.
Comments (English): [ Warranty service is slow - still not working ] || ---------------- || Our Bosch dishwasher was installed on January 21, 2025. It had a problem since the start. First time running we received a error message approximately 45 minutes into the wash cycle. After a few days of following Bosch website suggested fixes, we called to arrange for warranty work. The first available appointment was almost a full month later. Appointment date arrives, technician was late. He ran a diagnostic test and indicated that the unit passed the diagnostic test. He discussed the possibility that the unit was over-sudsing and discussed proper amounts of dishwasher detergent. On the chance there was still an issue, he ordered parts based upon the error message. Now, shouldn't he have had said parts already since we provided the error message to Bosch when we scheduled the service call. He scheduled a return visit - first available date March 10, 2025. Our appointment is scheduled for March 19, 2025 almost 2 months after installation. I really do not have much confidence that it will work at that time. They do not stck around long enough to see if a wash cycle completes successfully - or at the very least are not available for a quick turn-around to address any lingering issues. Maybe I'll issue a new review, if and when it works for us.

As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. (2)도어를 열었을 때 뜨거운 수증기에 의해 화상을 입을 수 있습니다. ***따라서 코스가 시작된지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에 얼른 추가하시고, 시간이 얼마간 지났다면 다음번에 세척하시는 게 낫겠습니다.  3️⃣자동 문 열림이 됩니다. 식기세척기를 이미 쓰고 계시던 분들께서 꼭 강조하시던 점이 '세척 끝나고 문이 열리는 기능이 중요하다'고 하시더라구요. 그래서 미디어 6인용 식기세척기는 작지만 강하다! 라고 말할 수 있을 거 같아요. 코스가 끝난 뒤에는 자동으로 문이 \'달칵\' 열리면서 건조를 빠르게 도와줍니다. 건조까지 10분 완전 끝난 후에는 짧은 멜로디가 나오면서  세척이 완료되었음을 알려줍니다.  ✅️ 6인용이라 참 작겠다, 생각했는데요! 의외로 기존에 사용하던 그릇 중에 식세기 사용 가능한 그릇이 많이 없었고, 주로 음식을 먹는 식구는 2~3명뿐이라 6인용이라도 충분히 커버 가능하더라구요. 물론 식세기가 특히 거거익선이라고 하는 이유는 아마 전형적인 모양의 식기뿐 아니라 냄비, 조리도구, 아이들 식판, 반찬통 등등을 많이 넣어야 하기 때문인 거 같아요! 그래도 충분히 식세기 여사님의 도움을 받게 되어 무척 기쁘고, 정말로 설거지 시간이 줄어드니까 행복하네요 ✅️ 식세기를 사용함으로써 물이 확실히 절약되는 걸 확인했네요. 평소 제가 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더 많은 양의 그릇을 넣었을 때에도 일반 코스 기준 모든 세척이 끝난 후에 보니 총 5L도 채 안되는 물을 쓰더라구요. 평균보다 작은 설거지통을 쓰고 있는데 거기에 물을 받아보니 넘치지 않았더라구요! 식세기 사용설명서에도 물과 에너지 절약을 위해 애벌 설거지는 필요하지 않다고 되어 있으나 식기 오염도에 따라 일부는 따로 불렸다가 넣으시면 더 큰 세척 효과를 보실 수 있겠습니다. ----------------------------------------- 이상 실사용 후기였습니다. 제가 구매할 때도 다른 분들의 리뷰를 많이 참고하는 편이라 저 또한 도움이 되고자 리뷰를 남기니 쇼핑하실 때 도움이 되셨다면 ↓[도움이 돼요]↓ 한 번 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다:) 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong!
Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order date: 2024/09/24 Delivery date: 2024/09/25 Review date: 2024/10/04 1 It's good because the installation burden is small. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. (2)도어를 열었을 때 뜨거운 수증기에 의해 화상을 입을 수 있습니다. ***따라서 코스가 시작된지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에 얼른 추가하시고, 시간이 얼마간 지났다면 다음번에 세척하시는 게 낫겠습니다.  3️⃣자동 문 열림이 됩니다. 식기세척기를 이미 쓰고 계시던 분들께서 꼭 강조하시던 점이 '세척 끝나고 문이 열리는 기능이 중요하다'고 하시더라구요. 그래서 미디어 6인용 식기세척기는 작지만 강하다! 라고 말할 수 있을 거 같아요. 코스가 끝난 뒤에는 자동으로 문이 \'달칵\' 열리면서 건조를 빠르게 도와줍니다. 건조까지 10분 완전 끝난 후에는 짧은 멜로디가 나오면서  세척이 완료되었음을 알려줍니다.  ✅️ 6인용이라 참 작겠다, 생각했는데요! 의외로 기존에 사용하던 그릇 중에 식세기 사용 가능한 그릇이 많이 없었고, 주로 음식을 먹는 식구는 2~3명뿐이라 6인용이라도 충분히 커버 가능하더라구요. 물론 식세기가 특히 거거익선이라고 하는 이유는 아마 전형적인 모양의 식기뿐 아니라 냄비, 조리도구, 아이들 식판, 반찬통 등등을 많이 넣어야 하기 때문인 거 같아요! 그래도 충분히 식세기 여사님의 도움을 받게 되어 무척 기쁘고, 정말로 설거지 시간이 줄어드니까 행복하네요 ✅️ 식세기를 사용함으로써 물이 확실히 절약되는 걸 확인했네요. 평소 제가 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더 많은 양의 그릇을 넣었을 때에도 일반 코스 기준 모든 세척이 끝난 후에 보니 총 5L도 채 안되는 물을 쓰더라구요. 평균보다 작은 설거지통을 쓰고 있는데 거기에 물을 받아보니 넘치지 않았더라구요! 식세기 사용설명서에도 물과 에너지 절약을 위해 애벌 설거지는 필요하지 않다고 되어 있으나 식기 오염도에 따라 일부는 따로 불렸다가 넣으시면 더 큰 세척 효과를 보실 수 있겠습니다. ----------------------------------------- 이상 실사용 후기였습니다. 제가 구매할 때도 다른 분들의 리뷰를 많이 참고하는 편이라 저 또한 도움이 되고자 리뷰를 남기니 쇼핑하실 때 도움이 되셨다면 ↓[도움이 돼요]↓ 한 번 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다:) 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. (2)도어를 열었을 때 뜨거운 수증기에 의해 화상을 입을 수 있습니다. ***따라서 코스가 시작된지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에 얼른 추가하시고, 시간이 얼마간 지났다면 다음번에 세척하시는 게 낫겠습니다.  3️⃣자동 문 열림이 됩니다. 식기세척기를 이미 쓰고 계시던 분들께서 꼭 강조하시던 점이 '세척 끝나고 문이 열리는 기능이 중요하다'고 하시더라구요. 그래서 미디어 6인용 식기세척기는 작지만 강하다! 라고 말할 수 있을 거 같아요. 코스가 끝난 뒤에는 자동으로 문이 \'달칵\' 열리면서 건조를 빠르게 도와줍니다. 건조까지 10분 완전 끝난 후에는 짧은 멜로디가 나오면서  세척이 완료되었음을 알려줍니다.  ✅️ 6인용이라 참 작겠다, 생각했는데요! 의외로 기존에 사용하던 그릇 중에 식세기 사용 가능한 그릇이 많이 없었고, 주로 음식을 먹는 식구는 2~3명뿐이라 6인용이라도 충분히 커버 가능하더라구요. 물론 식세기가 특히 거거익선이라고 하는 이유는 아마 전형적인 모양의 식기뿐 아니라 냄비, 조리도구, 아이들 식판, 반찬통 등등을 많이 넣어야 하기 때문인 거 같아요! 그래도 충분히 식세기 여사님의 도움을 받게 되어 무척 기쁘고, 정말로 설거지 시간이 줄어드니까 행복하네요 ✅️ 식세기를 사용함으로써 물이 확실히 절약되는 걸 확인했네요. 평소 제가 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더 많은 양의 그릇을 넣었을 때에도 일반 코스 기준 모든 세척이 끝난 후에 보니 총 5L도 채 안되는 물을 쓰더라구요. 평균보다 작은 설거지통을 쓰고 있는데 거기에 물을 받아보니 넘치지 않았더라구요! 식세기 사용설명서에도 물과 에너지 절약을 위해 애벌 설거지는 필요하지 않다고 되어 있으나 식기 오염도에 따라 일부는 따로 불렸다가 넣으시면 더 큰 세척 효과를 보실 수 있겠습니다. ----------------------------------------- 이상 실사용 후기였습니다. 제가 구매할 때도 다른 분들의 리뷰를 많이 참고하는 편이라 저 또한 도움이 되고자 리뷰를 남기니 쇼핑하실 때 도움이 되셨다면 ↓[도움이 돼요]↓ 한 번 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다:) 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order date: 2024/09/24 Delivery date: 2024/09/25 Review date: 2024/10/04 1 It's good because the installation burden is small. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order date: 2024/09/24 Delivery date: 2024/09/25 Review date: 2024/10/04 1 It's good because the installation burden is small. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. (2)도어를 열었을 때 뜨거운 수증기에 의해 화상을 입을 수 있습니다. ***따라서 코스가 시작된지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에 얼른 추가하시고, 시간이 얼마간 지났다면 다음번에 세척하시는 게 낫겠습니다.  3️⃣자동 문 열림이 됩니다. 식기세척기를 이미 쓰고 계시던 분들께서 꼭 강조하시던 점이 '세척 끝나고 문이 열리는 기능이 중요하다'고 하시더라구요. 그래서 미디어 6인용 식기세척기는 작지만 강하다! 라고 말할 수 있을 거 같아요. 코스가 끝난 뒤에는 자동으로 문이 \'달칵\' 열리면서 건조를 빠르게 도와줍니다. 건조까지 10분 완전 끝난 후에는 짧은 멜로디가 나오면서  세척이 완료되었음을 알려줍니다.  ✅️ 6인용이라 참 작겠다, 생각했는데요! 의외로 기존에 사용하던 그릇 중에 식세기 사용 가능한 그릇이 많이 없었고, 주로 음식을 먹는 식구는 2~3명뿐이라 6인용이라도 충분히 커버 가능하더라구요. 물론 식세기가 특히 거거익선이라고 하는 이유는 아마 전형적인 모양의 식기뿐 아니라 냄비, 조리도구, 아이들 식판, 반찬통 등등을 많이 넣어야 하기 때문인 거 같아요! 그래도 충분히 식세기 여사님의 도움을 받게 되어 무척 기쁘고, 정말로 설거지 시간이 줄어드니까 행복하네요 ✅️ 식세기를 사용함으로써 물이 확실히 절약되는 걸 확인했네요. 평소 제가 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더 많은 양의 그릇을 넣었을 때에도 일반 코스 기준 모든 세척이 끝난 후에 보니 총 5L도 채 안되는 물을 쓰더라구요. 평균보다 작은 설거지통을 쓰고 있는데 거기에 물을 받아보니 넘치지 않았더라구요! 식세기 사용설명서에도 물과 에너지 절약을 위해 애벌 설거지는 필요하지 않다고 되어 있으나 식기 오염도에 따라 일부는 따로 불렸다가 넣으시면 더 큰 세척 효과를 보실 수 있겠습니다. ----------------------------------------- 이상 실사용 후기였습니다. 제가 구매할 때도 다른 분들의 리뷰를 많이 참고하는 편이라 저 또한 도움이 되고자 리뷰를 남기니 쇼핑하실 때 도움이 되셨다면 ↓[도움이 돼요]↓ 한 번 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다:) 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order date: 2024/09/24 Delivery date: 2024/09/25 Review date: 2024/10/04 1 It's good because the installation burden is small. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. (2)도어를 열었을 때 뜨거운 수증기에 의해 화상을 입을 수 있습니다. ***따라서 코스가 시작된지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에 얼른 추가하시고, 시간이 얼마간 지났다면 다음번에 세척하시는 게 낫겠습니다.  3️⃣자동 문 열림이 됩니다. 식기세척기를 이미 쓰고 계시던 분들께서 꼭 강조하시던 점이 '세척 끝나고 문이 열리는 기능이 중요하다'고 하시더라구요. 그래서 미디어 6인용 식기세척기는 작지만 강하다! 라고 말할 수 있을 거 같아요. 코스가 끝난 뒤에는 자동으로 문이 \'달칵\' 열리면서 건조를 빠르게 도와줍니다. 건조까지 10분 완전 끝난 후에는 짧은 멜로디가 나오면서  세척이 완료되었음을 알려줍니다.  ✅️ 6인용이라 참 작겠다, 생각했는데요! 의외로 기존에 사용하던 그릇 중에 식세기 사용 가능한 그릇이 많이 없었고, 주로 음식을 먹는 식구는 2~3명뿐이라 6인용이라도 충분히 커버 가능하더라구요. 물론 식세기가 특히 거거익선이라고 하는 이유는 아마 전형적인 모양의 식기뿐 아니라 냄비, 조리도구, 아이들 식판, 반찬통 등등을 많이 넣어야 하기 때문인 거 같아요! 그래도 충분히 식세기 여사님의 도움을 받게 되어 무척 기쁘고, 정말로 설거지 시간이 줄어드니까 행복하네요 ✅️ 식세기를 사용함으로써 물이 확실히 절약되는 걸 확인했네요. 평소 제가 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더 많은 양의 그릇을 넣었을 때에도 일반 코스 기준 모든 세척이 끝난 후에 보니 총 5L도 채 안되는 물을 쓰더라구요. 평균보다 작은 설거지통을 쓰고 있는데 거기에 물을 받아보니 넘치지 않았더라구요! 식세기 사용설명서에도 물과 에너지 절약을 위해 애벌 설거지는 필요하지 않다고 되어 있으나 식기 오염도에 따라 일부는 따로 불렸다가 넣으시면 더 큰 세척 효과를 보실 수 있겠습니다. ----------------------------------------- 이상 실사용 후기였습니다. 제가 구매할 때도 다른 분들의 리뷰를 많이 참고하는 편이라 저 또한 도움이 되고자 리뷰를 남기니 쇼핑하실 때 도움이 되셨다면 ↓[도움이 돼요]↓ 한 번 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다:) 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order date: 2024/09/24 Delivery date: 2024/09/25 Review date: 2024/10/04 1 It's good because the installation burden is small. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. (2)도어를 열었을 때 뜨거운 수증기에 의해 화상을 입을 수 있습니다. ***따라서 코스가 시작된지 얼마 되지 않았을 때에 얼른 추가하시고, 시간이 얼마간 지났다면 다음번에 세척하시는 게 낫겠습니다.  3️⃣자동 문 열림이 됩니다. 식기세척기를 이미 쓰고 계시던 분들께서 꼭 강조하시던 점이 '세척 끝나고 문이 열리는 기능이 중요하다'고 하시더라구요. 그래서 미디어 6인용 식기세척기는 작지만 강하다! 라고 말할 수 있을 거 같아요. 코스가 끝난 뒤에는 자동으로 문이 \'달칵\' 열리면서 건조를 빠르게 도와줍니다. 건조까지 10분 완전 끝난 후에는 짧은 멜로디가 나오면서  세척이 완료되었음을 알려줍니다.  ✅️ 6인용이라 참 작겠다, 생각했는데요! 의외로 기존에 사용하던 그릇 중에 식세기 사용 가능한 그릇이 많이 없었고, 주로 음식을 먹는 식구는 2~3명뿐이라 6인용이라도 충분히 커버 가능하더라구요. 물론 식세기가 특히 거거익선이라고 하는 이유는 아마 전형적인 모양의 식기뿐 아니라 냄비, 조리도구, 아이들 식판, 반찬통 등등을 많이 넣어야 하기 때문인 거 같아요! 그래도 충분히 식세기 여사님의 도움을 받게 되어 무척 기쁘고, 정말로 설거지 시간이 줄어드니까 행복하네요 ✅️ 식세기를 사용함으로써 물이 확실히 절약되는 걸 확인했네요. 평소 제가 손으로 설거지할 때보다 더 많은 양의 그릇을 넣었을 때에도 일반 코스 기준 모든 세척이 끝난 후에 보니 총 5L도 채 안되는 물을 쓰더라구요. 평균보다 작은 설거지통을 쓰고 있는데 거기에 물을 받아보니 넘치지 않았더라구요! 식세기 사용설명서에도 물과 에너지 절약을 위해 애벌 설거지는 필요하지 않다고 되어 있으나 식기 오염도에 따라 일부는 따로 불렸다가 넣으시면 더 큰 세척 효과를 보실 수 있겠습니다. ----------------------------------------- 이상 실사용 후기였습니다. 제가 구매할 때도 다른 분들의 리뷰를 많이 참고하는 편이라 저 또한 도움이 되고자 리뷰를 남기니 쇼핑하실 때 도움이 되셨다면 ↓[도움이 돼요]↓ 한 번 눌러주시면 감사하겠습니다:) 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Comments (English): [ Small but mighty! ] || ---------------- || Order date: 2024/09/24 Delivery date: 2024/09/25 Review date: 2024/10/04 1 It's good because the installation burden is small. The Media 6-person dishwasher has a small hole size of 10mm, which minimizes the hole area and reduces the installation burden, and the technician really installed the water pipe with a hole the size of a fingernail. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. (2) You may get burned by the hot steam when you open the door. ***Therefore, it is better to add it quickly when the course has just started, and wash it next time after some time has passed. 3 It has an automatic door opening. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. Even when I put in more dishes than when I usually wash dishes by hand, I used less than 5L of water after all the washing was done based on the regular course. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. As a tenant, I was a little worried about installing a new dishwasher, but it was good that it was installed without causing major damage. 2 You can add dishes in the middle. (There is a caution) Even if the washing cycle has already started, you can press the pause () button to add dishes and press the same button again to proceed. However, please note that (1) if the cycle has already progressed a lot, depending on the contamination level of the additional dishes, the dishes that have already been washed may become contaminated, and the additional dishes may not be washed cleanly. People who have already used dishwashers emphasize that 'the function of the door opening after washing is important'. So I think I can say that the Media 6-person dishwasher is small but strong! After the course is over, the door opens automatically with a \"click\" to help with drying quickly. After 10 minutes of drying, a short melody plays to let you know that the washing is complete. I thought it would be small because it is for 6 people! Surprisingly, there were not many dishes that I used before that could be used in the dishwasher, and since there are only 2-3 people who usually eat, it is enough to cover even for 6 people. Of course, the reason why the dishwasher is especially big is probably because it has to hold not only typical-shaped dishes, but also pots, cooking utensils, children's plates, lunch boxes, etc.! Still, I am very happy to have received enough help from the dishwasher lady, and I am really happy because the dishwashing time has been reduced. I have confirmed that water is definitely saved by using the dishwasher. I am using a smaller dishwashing bin than average, but when I filled it with water, it did not overflow! The dishwasher user manual says that pre-washing is not necessary to save water and energy, but depending on the level of contamination, you can see a greater cleaning effect if you soak some of the dishes separately and then put them in. ----------------------------------------- This is my actual review. Comments (English): [ A must-have for husbands these days! ] || ---------------- || <Review after 2 months of use> It's been a little over 2 months since I got used to the dish Tetris, and I'm experiencing a whole new world. It may only take a few minutes a day, but since I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, I have a lot of free time, which is great^^ I turn it once every 2-3 days, and it takes about 3 minutes to put the dishes in and turn it^^ It's already been about a month since I started using it. I was going to write a review right after purchasing it, but I'm writing this review now to write a more honest and truthful review. At first, I couldn't get used to the dish Tetris after installing it, but I'm finally getting used to it a little now. I was hesitant because it was expensive after thinking about it for about 2 years, but when the price went down a little, I boldly bought a dishwasher! To be honest, I regret buying it so late. People who haven't used a dishwasher say that they have to do pre-washing anyway, such as removing food, so why spend so much money on a dishwasher when they're going to just wash the dishes by hand, but after using it for about a month, I realized that that's nonsense^^ My hands get wet, but the dishwashing time is greatly reduced and it's incredibly convenient. Should I say that I have more free time in my life? Reason for purchase - I feel like I waste time washing dishes every day - The price has gone down a lot compared to before - I'm too tired to wash the dishes after working all day - I hate the rough feeling on my hands. Before purchasing the dishwasher, I washed the dishes every day, but now I just collect the dishes and do it once every two days. It saves time, is less tiring, and is so convenient. It's so convenient that I regret buying it late. In terms of functionality - It really cleans better than washing dishes by hand. - It has high-temperature washing, steam, and hot air drying, so I can trust the cleanliness. - There may be individual differences, but the sound isn't loud so it's not annoying at all. (Refer to the video) - As you can see in the picture, the detergent place has been improved and is conveniently located on the lower drying rack (Refer to the picture) Sink storage cabinet construction - The sink in my house has narrow spaces so the dishwasher takes up 1.5 spaces, but on the day of delivery, the delivery person finished the sink construction very neatly so no separate construction was necessary (The right storage cabinet you see in the picture is the sink that was cut and reattached that day and reduced by half. It's really neat and tidy) Precautions - Be careful with plastic containers due to high temperatures such as high-temperature washing and steam.

Sentence (English): I am a family of 4 and live in a rented house, so I was looking for a dishwasher that would not work, and I came across Samsung.
Comments (English): I am a family of 4 and live in a rented house, so I was looking for a dishwasher that would not work, and I came across Samsung. The reviews were so good and it was trustworthy, so I bought it. I washed the dishes and put them in without any residue and turned it on. It took 1 hour and 8 minutes for the standard time, and I heard the sound of water, and then it started working. It seems that the water drained 2.3 times. When I looked at the amount of water that came out, it was much smaller than the amount of water that I keep turning on while washing dishes. I wondered if this amount of water would be enough to wash the dishes, but the dishes were washed very cleanly. It works very well. The dishwasher for 6 people can hold a lot of food, and I am very satisfied because I don't have to wash the dishes with my wrists hurting. The installer was kind and installed it on the date I wanted. I wonder why I suffered so much if I had bought it earlier. It's nice that my husband and I don't have to fight over the dishes. I can do other household chores and teach the kids while I'm washing the dishes, and I have more free time in the evening^^ The best (If you found my review helpful, please click \"Helpful\"^^)

Sentence (English): It was washed cleanly and the washing result is satisfactory.
Comments (English): It was washed cleanly and the washing result is satisfactory. I put in half of the pro* baking soda type, known as Kim Hye-ja detergent. I used the standard washing course of 1 hour and 10 minutes and operated it with the washing machine filled to about 75%. I put in several thin plates, but I did not put in deep dishes such as rice bowls or soup bowls so that the water could reach the inside. It was removed cleanly without any red pepper powder, rice paste, etc. It was a perfect dishwashing with no stains and no stains. For those who said that there were foreign substances, I suggest putting in a little less dishes. Precautions: After installation, run the washing mode once. Rinse with water once with larvae and then put the dishes in. It is recommended to wash large utensils such as pots and frying pans directly. Since there is no automatic drying function, open the machine door immediately after washing and clean the strainer once. Overall review: I am so happy to have my first dishwasher. In fact, it may be frustrating that the dishwasher takes an hour to run the dishwashing machine when I can finish the dishes in 20 minutes if I do it myself. But as a mother, I no longer have to shout, "Mom, I'll be right back!" when the baby comes looking for me. Instead of having to quickly wash the dishes while the baby is eating breakfast, I can now have a sweet breakfast face to face with the baby. That makes me happy^^

Comments (English): [ Thank you, Auntie Dishwasher^^ ] || ---------------- || ## Purchased model: DW30CB300CW0 (white) It is a 6-person dishwasher, but it holds enough food, so you only have to run it once a day. It is so convenient to put all the cups, side dishes, spoons, and other annoying things in it and run it. Gas prices have gone up a lot lately, so I was worried every time I washed dishes with hot water, but this is killing two birds with one stone because it is convenient with a small amount of water. I was looking for a dishwasher for a few days during the holiday break, so I searched YouTube and blogs and bought the Samsung Bespoke desktop, and I am really satisfied. There was also a holiday event, so the price was really cheap. I excluded the 12-person one because I had to bend over, and the LG has a door that opens up and down, so I passed (the space above the sink is narrow), and the SK has two stages, so it seems difficult to put pots and frying pans in, and the Samsung Bespoke dishwasher prevents water from dripping onto the floor when the door opens downwards and rinses it, so water does not drip onto the floor or sink, which is nice. The entire wall is made of stainless steel, so it feels safer, and the previous model used less water but had a longer operating time, while the new model used a little more water and had a little less operating time. However, I felt that using more water was more thorough, so I bought the new model even though it was more expensive. There was an upgraded version that could dry with hot air, but I bought it for energy conservation, so I don't think I'll really use the hot air drying function. Also, the price was a little expensive, so I chose this one for cost-effectiveness. The final rinse is finished at a high temperature, so even if you open the door slightly, you can use fluffy dishes right away even if you dry them naturally. I ordered it on Tuesday morning and received it on Wednesday morning. Rocket Wow is really great. One thing I regret about Samsung is that when the dishwasher arrived, they used to give me one or two free samples of detergent, but I couldn't use it right away, so I ordered the detergent again with Rocket Delivery and received it right away on Wednesday evening. Now I don't have to fight over who will do the dishes, and it's a whole new world. Thank you. <<One-month review>> This month, the management fee came out, and the water bill went down by 10,000 won. I guess I wasted a lot of water while washing dishes. I think I should check the water bill next month and write an additional review. <<Two-month review>> The water bill for the second month was the same as last month. I can definitely tell that the water bill went down after using the dishwasher. Awesome! <<Please Samsung>> When using the dishwasher, sometimes I wish it had just rinsed once more. Usually, washing machines only allow you to add rinse. I can definitely tell that the water bill went down after using the dishwasher. Awesome! <<Please Samsung>> When using the dishwasher, sometimes I wish it had just rinsed once more. Usually, washing machines only allow you to add rinse. So I asked the head office if I could add only rinse during the wash cycle, but they said that non-desktop products have that function, but this one doesn't. It's a shame, but I think I'll have to hold out even if I only want to rinse. Please add this function for the next renewal.

Gas prices have gone up a lot lately, so I was worried every time I washed dishes with hot water, but this is killing two birds with one stone because it is convenient with a small amount of water. I was looking for a dishwasher for a few days during the holiday break, so I searched YouTube and blogs and bought the Samsung Bespoke desktop, and I am really satisfied. There was also a holiday event, so the price was really cheap. I excluded the 12-person one because I had to bend over, and the LG has a door that opens up and down, so I passed (the space above the sink is narrow), and the SK has two stages, so it seems difficult to put pots and frying pans in, and the Samsung Bespoke dishwasher prevents water from dripping onto the floor when the door opens downwards and rinses it, so water does not drip onto the floor or sink, which is nice. The entire wall is made of stainless steel, so it feels safer, and the previous model used less water but had a longer operating time, while the new model used a little more water and had a little less operating time. However, I felt that using more water was more thorough, so I bought the new model even though it was more expensive. There was an upgraded version that could dry with hot air, but I bought it for energy conservation, so I don't think I'll really use the hot air drying function. Also, the price was a little expensive, so I chose this one for cost-effectiveness. The final rinse is finished at a high temperature, so even if you open the door slightly, you can use fluffy dishes right away even if you dry them naturally. I ordered it on Tuesday morning and received it on Wednesday morning. Rocket Wow is really great. One thing I regret about Samsung is that when the dishwasher arrived, they used to give me one or two free samples of detergent, but I couldn't use it right away, so I ordered the detergent again with Rocket Delivery and received it right away on Wednesday evening. Now I don't have to fight over who will do the dishes, and it's a whole new world. Thank you. <<One-month review>> This month, the management fee came out, and the water bill went down by 10,000 won. I guess I wasted a lot of water while washing dishes. I think I should check the water bill next month and write an additional review. <<Two-month review>> The water bill for the second month was the same as last month. I can definitely tell that the water bill went down after using the dishwasher. Awesome! <<Please Samsung>> When using the dishwasher, sometimes I wish it had just rinsed once more. Usually, washing machines only allow you to add rinse. So I asked the head office if I could add only rinse during the wash cycle, but they said that non-desktop products have that function, but this one doesn't. It's a shame, but I think I'll have to hold out even if I only want to rinse. Please add this function for the next renewal.

It is so convenient to put all the cups, side dishes, spoons, and other annoying things in it and run it. Gas prices have gone up a lot lately, so I was worried every time I washed dishes with hot water, but this is killing two birds with one stone because it is convenient with a small amount of water. I was looking for a dishwasher for a few days during the holiday break, so I searched YouTube and blogs and bought the Samsung Bespoke desktop, and I am really satisfied. There was also a holiday event, so the price was really cheap. I excluded the 12-person one because I had to bend over, and the LG has a door that opens up and down, so I passed (the space above the sink is narrow), and the SK has two stages, so it seems difficult to put pots and frying pans in, and the Samsung Bespoke dishwasher prevents water from dripping onto the floor when the door opens downwards and rinses it, so water does not drip onto the floor or sink, which is nice. The entire wall is made of stainless steel, so it feels safer, and the previous model used less water but had a longer operating time, while the new model used a little more water and had a little less operating time. However, I felt that using more water was more thorough, so I bought the new model even though it was more expensive. There was an upgraded version that could dry with hot air, but I bought it for energy conservation, so I don't think I'll really use the hot air drying function. Also, the price was a little expensive, so I chose this one for cost-effectiveness. The final rinse is finished at a high temperature, so even if you open the door slightly, you can use fluffy dishes right away even if you dry them naturally. I ordered it on Tuesday morning and received it on Wednesday morning. Rocket Wow is really great. One thing I regret about Samsung is that when the dishwasher arrived, they used to give me one or two free samples of detergent, but I couldn't use it right away, so I ordered the detergent again with Rocket Delivery and received it right away on Wednesday evening. Now I don't have to fight over who will do the dishes, and it's a whole new world. Thank you. <<One-month review>> This month, the management fee came out, and the water bill went down by 10,000 won. I guess I wasted a lot of water while washing dishes. I think I should check the water bill next month and write an additional review. <<Two-month review>> The water bill for the second month was the same as last month. I can definitely tell that the water bill went down after using the dishwasher. Awesome! <<Please Samsung>> When using the dishwasher, sometimes I wish it had just rinsed once more. Usually, washing machines only allow you to add rinse. So I asked the head office if I could add only rinse during the wash cycle, but they said that non-desktop products have that function, but this one doesn't. It's a shame, but I think I'll have to hold out even if I only want to rinse. Please add this function for the next renewal.
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 이모님 감사합니다^^ ] || ---------------- || ## 구입모델 : DW30CB300CW0(화이트)  6인용 식기세척기이지만 충분히 많은 양이 들어가서 하루 한번만 돌려도 되네요. 컵이랑 반찬통 수저등 씻기 귀찮은 것들 싹다 넣어서 돌리니 너무 편합니다. 요즘 가스값이 많이 올라서 뜨거운 물로 설거지 할때마다 걱정이 좀 됬는데 이건 적은 물 사용량으로 간편하기까지 하니 일석이조네요. 며칠동안 식세기 사려고 명절 쉴때 유투브, 블로그 다 뒤져보고 삼성비스포크 데스크탑으로 들인거라 진짜 대만족입니다. 명절 이벤트도 있었는지 금액도 정말 저렴했어요.  12인용은 허리를 굽혀야해서 제외시켰고, 엘지는 문이 위아래 개폐방식이라 패스(씽크대 윗 공간이 협소함), sk는 2단이라 냄비나 후라이팬은 넣기 힘들것 같고…  삼성비스포크 식기세척기는 아래로 문이 열리면 헹궈서 집어넣을때 바닥으로 물떨어지는 걸 막아주니 바닥이나 싱크대로 물이 안떨어져서 좋아요.  벽 전체가 스텐이라 왠지 더 안전한 느낌도 들고 이전 모델은 물 사용량이 적으면서 가동시간이 몇분 더 길고, 신모델은 물 사용량이 좀 늘어나고 가동시간이 좀 줄었더라구요. 근데 저는 물을 좀더 많이 사용하는게 더 깨끗하게 씻기는 느낌이라 가격이 나가도 신모델로 구매했습니다. 열풍건조가 가능한 업그레이드버전 모델도 있었지만 에너지절약 차원에서 구매한거라 굳이 열풍건조 기능은 거의 안쓸것 같더라구요. 또한 가격도 좀 비싸서 가성비면에서 저는 이걸로 선택했어요. 마지막 헹굼이 온도가 높은 상태로 끝나서 문이 살짝 열려지는 것 만으로도 자연건조해도 금방 보송 보송한 그릇을 쓸수 있어요.  화요일 새벽에 주문하고, 수요일 아침에 받았어요. 로켓와우 진짜 대박인듯요 ㅎㅎ  삼성에 아쉬운점은 식세기 올때 예전에는 맛보기 세제를 한두개 줬는데 안줘서 바로 못돌리고, 다시 로켓배송으로 세제 주문해서 수요일 저녁에 바로 받아 돌렸어요.  이제 누가 설거지 할건지 눈치싸움 안해도 되고, 너무 신세계입니다. 감사합니다.  <<한달 사용후기>> 이번달 관리비가 나왔는데 수도세가 만원이나 줄었어요. 아무래도 설겆이하면서 틀어서 버리는 물의 양이 상당했나봅니다. 다음달 수도세도 체크좀 해보고 다시 추가 후기 써야될듯요.  <<두달 사용후기>>  두번째달도 지난달과 동일한 양의 수도세가 나왔어요. 진짜 식세기 사용후 수도세가 준것 확실하네요. 대박!!  <<삼성에 부탁합니다>> 식세기를 사용하다보면 가끔 헹굼만 추가로 한번 더 했으면 하는 생각이 들때가 있어요. 보통 세탁기에서는 헹굼만 추가로 선택할수 있잖아요. 그래서 세척코스 중에 다른거 말고 헹굼만 추가 할수는 없을까 싶어 본사에 문의봤는데 데스크탑 아닌 제품들에는 있는데 이건 그 기능은 없다고 하더라구요. 아쉬웠지만 헹굼만 하고 싶을때가 있더라도 참아야 할것 같아요. 다음번 리뉴얼시에는 꼭 이 기능 추가해주세요.

There was also a holiday event, so the price was really cheap. I excluded the 12-person one because I had to bend over, and the LG has a door that opens up and down, so I passed (the space above the sink is narrow), and the SK has two stages, so it seems difficult to put pots and frying pans in, and the Samsung Bespoke dishwasher prevents water from dripping onto the floor when the door opens downwards and rinses it, so water does not drip onto the floor or sink, which is nice. I can definitely tell that the water bill went down after using the dishwasher. Awesome! <<Please Samsung>> When using the dishwasher, sometimes I wish it had just rinsed once more. It's a shame, but I think I'll have to hold out even if I only want to rinse. Please add this function for the next renewal.

It is so convenient to put all the cups, side dishes, spoons, and other annoying things in it and run it. Gas prices have gone up a lot lately, so I was worried every time I washed dishes with hot water, but this is killing two birds with one stone because it is convenient with a small amount of water. I was looking for a dishwasher for a few days during the holiday break, so I searched YouTube and blogs and bought the Samsung Bespoke desktop, and I am really satisfied. There was also a holiday event, so the price was really cheap. I excluded the 12-person one because I had to bend over, and the LG has a door that opens up and down, so I passed (the space above the sink is narrow), and the SK has two stages, so it seems difficult to put pots and frying pans in, and the Samsung Bespoke dishwasher prevents water from dripping onto the floor when the door opens downwards and rinses it, so water does not drip onto the floor or sink, which is nice. The entire wall is made of stainless steel, so it feels safer, and the previous model used less water but had a longer operating time, while the new model used a little more water and had a little less operating time. However, I felt that using more water was more thorough, so I bought the new model even though it was more expensive. There was an upgraded version that could dry with hot air, but I bought it for energy conservation, so I don't think I'll really use the hot air drying function. Also, the price was a little expensive, so I chose this one for cost-effectiveness. The final rinse is finished at a high temperature, so even if you open the door slightly, you can use fluffy dishes right away even if you dry them naturally. I ordered it on Tuesday morning and received it on Wednesday morning. Rocket Wow is really great. One thing I regret about Samsung is that when the dishwasher arrived, they used to give me one or two free samples of detergent, but I couldn't use it right away, so I ordered the detergent again with Rocket Delivery and received it right away on Wednesday evening. Now I don't have to fight over who will do the dishes, and it's a whole new world. Thank you. <<One-month review>> This month, the management fee came out, and the water bill went down by 10,000 won. I guess I wasted a lot of water while washing dishes. I think I should check the water bill next month and write an additional review. <<Two-month review>> The water bill for the second month was the same as last month. I can definitely tell that the water bill went down after using the dishwasher. Awesome! <<Please Samsung>> When using the dishwasher, sometimes I wish it had just rinsed once more. Usually, washing machines only allow you to add rinse. So I asked the head office if I could add only rinse during the wash cycle, but they said that non-desktop products have that function, but this one doesn't. It's a shame, but I think I'll have to hold out even if I only want to rinse. Please add this function for the next renewal.
Comments (Original): [ 식세기 이모님 감사합니다^^ ] || ---------------- || ## 구입모델 : DW30CB300CW0(화이트)  6인용 식기세척기이지만 충분히 많은 양이 들어가서 하루 한번만 돌려도 되네요. 컵이랑 반찬통 수저등 씻기 귀찮은 것들 싹다 넣어서 돌리니 너무 편합니다. 요즘 가스값이 많이 올라서 뜨거운 물로 설거지 할때마다 걱정이 좀 됬는데 이건 적은 물 사용량으로 간편하기까지 하니 일석이조네요. 며칠동안 식세기 사려고 명절 쉴때 유투브, 블로그 다 뒤져보고 삼성비스포크 데스크탑으로 들인거라 진짜 대만족입니다. 명절 이벤트도 있었는지 금액도 정말 저렴했어요.  12인용은 허리를 굽혀야해서 제외시켰고, 엘지는 문이 위아래 개폐방식이라 패스(씽크대 윗 공간이 협소함), sk는 2단이라 냄비나 후라이팬은 넣기 힘들것 같고…  삼성비스포크 식기세척기는 아래로 문이 열리면 헹궈서 집어넣을때 바닥으로 물떨어지는 걸 막아주니 바닥이나 싱크대로 물이 안떨어져서 좋아요.  벽 전체가 스텐이라 왠지 더 안전한 느낌도 들고 이전 모델은 물 사용량이 적으면서 가동시간이 몇분 더 길고, 신모델은 물 사용량이 좀 늘어나고 가동시간이 좀 줄었더라구요. 근데 저는 물을 좀더 많이 사용하는게 더 깨끗하게 씻기는 느낌이라 가격이 나가도 신모델로 구매했습니다. 열풍건조가 가능한 업그레이드버전 모델도 있었지만 에너지절약 차원에서 구매한거라 굳이 열풍건조 기능은 거의 안쓸것 같더라구요. 또한 가격도 좀 비싸서 가성비면에서 저는 이걸로 선택했어요. 마지막 헹굼이 온도가 높은 상태로 끝나서 문이 살짝 열려지는 것 만으로도 자연건조해도 금방 보송 보송한 그릇을 쓸수 있어요.  화요일 새벽에 주문하고, 수요일 아침에 받았어요. 로켓와우 진짜 대박인듯요 ㅎㅎ  삼성에 아쉬운점은 식세기 올때 예전에는 맛보기 세제를 한두개 줬는데 안줘서 바로 못돌리고, 다시 로켓배송으로 세제 주문해서 수요일 저녁에 바로 받아 돌렸어요.  이제 누가 설거지 할건지 눈치싸움 안해도 되고, 너무 신세계입니다. 감사합니다.  <<한달 사용후기>> 이번달 관리비가 나왔는데 수도세가 만원이나 줄었어요. 아무래도 설겆이하면서 틀어서 버리는 물의 양이 상당했나봅니다. 다음달 수도세도 체크좀 해보고 다시 추가 후기 써야될듯요.  <<두달 사용후기>>  두번째달도 지난달과 동일한 양의 수도세가 나왔어요. 진짜 식세기 사용후 수도세가 준것 확실하네요. 대박!!  <<삼성에 부탁합니다>> 식세기를 사용하다보면 가끔 헹굼만 추가로 한번 더 했으면 하는 생각이 들때가 있어요. 보통 세탁기에서는 헹굼만 추가로 선택할수 있잖아요. 그래서 세척코스 중에 다른거 말고 헹굼만 추가 할수는 없을까 싶어 본사에 문의봤는데 데스크탑 아닌 제품들에는 있는데 이건 그 기능은 없다고 하더라구요. 아쉬웠지만 헹굼만 하고 싶을때가 있더라도 참아야 할것 같아요. 다음번 리뉴얼시에는 꼭 이 기능 추가해주세요.

Sentence (English): My Cafe dishwasher was installed 2 days ago.
Comments (English): [ Small Space Dishwasher Solution ] || ---------------- || My Cafe dishwasher was installed 2 days ago. The drawer design is perfect for my small kitchen (because the normal dishwasher door likely would strike the stove across from it). This model is like having 2 dishwashers and since I live alone, I am frequently running small loads. Please use a rinse agent. I tried just running it with powdered dishwasher detergent on the regular setting and was disappointed but with the rinse agent and on the pot setting dishes came out sparkling without streaks. (One downside is the plastic kick is way too tall to fit). So far my experience has been — a quiet dishwasher, easy to operate, has fold down racks (still getting used to loading it). On the whole its a hit!

Sentence (English): Very pleased with this dishwasher so far!
Comments (English): [ Clean and dry dishes! Very pleased overall ] || ---------------- || Very pleased with this dishwasher so far! My last dishwasher was a Frigidaire and only lasted for 4 years with not much usage which was disappointing. I've only used the normal and auto sense wash modes so far but the dishes have come out really clean! The dishwasher is so quiet it's a whisper level and can barely tell it's running. I've been happy with how it dries as well-the normal dry boost mode is sufficient the dishes are dry but small pools of water remain on the dishes with concave tops. The high dry boost mode leaves them bone dry which I prefer. The top rack and bottle jets are a nice bonus as well. The only negatives I've found so far are it doesn't clean the silverware as well as past models with some food remaining on utensils in the lower utensils basket (hoping there maybe a trick to placing them in it I'm missing :)-the capacity of the dishes it holds is also noticeably less than other models I've had and the cycle times are very long. The auto sense and normal modes when using the high dry boost option run for nearly 4 hours. It doesn't much matter to me as I run my dishwasher late night but it maybe a factor for some. Overall I'm very pleased with this model it's exceeded my expectations

Sentence (English): I absolutely hate this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ WORST DISHWASHER IVE EVER USED ] || ---------------- || I absolutely hate this dishwasher. It is the most unintuitive, overly complicated with minimal features of any appliance I've ever used. The only thing positive I can say about it is that it's quiet. This ends up being a double edged sword because I barely know if it's actually running. If you like dry dishes after a cycle, this is not the dishwasher for you. Our dishes come out soaked even when running the “extra dry” cycle. The answer from Bosch? Add more chemicals to the load and use a rinse aid. No thank you. The rack design is terrible. About 50% of the stuff I try to load just falls over because the rack tines are poorly laid out the base of rack has way to many angles. There is no delayed start. Our routine is to typically load after dinner then do a 2 hour delayed start so if we have the late night bowl of ice cream, we can still add it to the load, but if we don't, we don't have to worry about remembering to starting it. There is a remote start in the app, but when you permanently enable it, it's almost impossible to reliably get it to start manually. Sometimes I can get it to work, sometimes not. I will repeat the manual start process 5 times, exactly the same with each try, and magically on the 5th time it works. The other 4 times is just beeps at me and says the cycle is paused. What? Oh, and to use the app, you have to be on the wifi network? All that does is save me a few steps. I want to be able to start it from work or in the car if I realize I forgot to run it. I don't want to load it, close the door, then have to pull out my phone to start it and like I said earlier, when you have the remote start enabled, it's a pain in the blank to get it to start manually. All in all, this dishwasher sucks and I would NEVER recommend it to anyone. We've had it for about a month now and I'm considering seeing what I can sell it for and buying something different. This is my first negative product review I've ever written. Normally, I wouldn't bother but I truly despise this machine. I hope this message saves someone the hassle of buying this dishwasher. I'll give it 2 stars because it is quiet and when you finally do figure out a way to load your dishes, it does hold a lot.

Sentence (English): My Bosch diswasher has been a huge disappointment in possible way.
Comments (English): [ 10 Reasons I HATE My New Washwasher! ] || ---------------- || My Bosch diswasher has been a huge disappointment in possible way. I did my research before I purched my Bosch and I saw only great review. I now must assume they were fake, AI, and/or sponsored by Boscho. Ten reasons I hate my Bosch: 1. I did not realize that many of the setting, even basics, MUST be done through the app. For example, rinse-only and china cycle. The App is terrible and will not connect to my dishwasher. I had a technician come to our house from the store where we bought the dishwasher. After quite a bit of struggling and several attempts, he was able to get the app connected to the WiFi on the dishwasher. BUT the next day when I went to open the app, it was no longer conncected and I cannot get it connected again. I DO NOT WANT TO OPERATE MY DISHWASHER FROM MY PHONE. 2) The inside of the dishwasher is much smaller than my old one, even though it is the same size outside. My regular-sized dinner plates standing upright hit the spray arm, so the dishes do not get clean. I have to put the plates every other slot and tilt them so they don't hit the spray arm. This means I end up running the dishwasher half full. 3) The particles on the dishes start to smell bad even after one day, so I have to run the dishwasher every. singe. day. I think it is because the instruction say to NOT rinse the dishes befor loading and the door is totally airtight. I tried adjusting the middle rack up, but then my regular-sized drinking glasses won't fit. 4) The touchpad is super-sensitive and most times it takes several attempts to get the dishwater started. 5) The forks, knives, and spoons on the top rack (3rd) rack do not always get clean. They have to be positioned 'just so' to ensure they aren't touching any other pieces or the plastic spikes that hold them in place. In fact, EVERYTHING must be postioned perfectly or the dishes do not get clean. 6) The placement of the spikes that hold plates and bowls up is really odd, so it doesn't work with any of my bowls. 7) For a high-end, high-priced appliance, the racks inside are extrement flimsy plastic. 8) I hate that the controls on my model are on the top of the door. I assume this is meant to make the dishwasher look more sleek, but it is totally impractical. There is nothing to show what stage of the wash/rinse/dray cycle is happening, and no way to pause or stop the dishwasher mid-cylce except opening the door (all the water will come out onto the floor). 9) The dish detergent leave a detergent smell on all the dishes, even though I have rinse-aid in the rinse-aid dispenser. The smell remains even after the dishes are unloaded and put away. 10) There is a VERY minimal instruction guide - just a couple of pages, mostly about installation. If I could return it, I certainly would.

Comments (English): [ A Solid Dishwasher, Drying is more Nuanced ] || ---------------- || I chose LG because they have had good reliability rates for appliances made in the last couple years (somewhere around 5% service rate within the first year of purchase. for context Bosch is at about 8-9%). This particular model's extra feature of note is the "TrueSteam" feature. It's an option that basically produces hot steam at the beginning of a cycle so that it sanitizes dishes and softens up whatever is soiled prior to the washing to begin. I wanted it mostly for the sanitize function.This DW cleans pretty well (sometimes so thick residue will remain if water couldn't adequately get to it), dries really well (more on this below), and runs mostly reasonably quiet. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who would want to make use of the steam feature. Otherwise I would recommend the next step below this model as everything else would work the same.On drying - This DW does not have a traditional heating element, instead opting for a condense-drying mechanic like the Bosch DWs do. They call it "Dynamic Dry" (NOT to be confused with "Dynamic Heat Dry", a more expensive option on other LG DW models). For this DW, it is important that you at least have rinse aid, the "Heat Dry" option selected (rinses dishes at the end of cycle with very hot water to facilitate condense drying), and the "Night Dry" option selected (Turns on an outlet fan for an hour after a cycle finishes to carry away moisture and dry). With these, non-plastic dishes will be dry and plastic will usually be 80% dry.
