Sentence (English): So far so good.
Comments (English): [ So far performs better than my mid level Bosch did ] || ---------------- || So far so good. I like our new dishwasher. It cleans well, even in the regular cycle (which is all I've had to use so far). As of now, I think it performs better than my previous mid level Bosch did. It's a tad louder. The spray arms discharge water when unloading clean dishes, so make sure you unload from the bottom rack upward or else your dry dishes will get wet. I can't get as much in while loading. This might be a good thing, because the tines are farther apart and dishes are probably getting cleaner. There is a lot of room between racks, so I can get taller pots and my food processor in more easily without adjusting the racks. The normal cycle with the extended drying option takes close to 3.5 hours. I appreciate having the 3rd rack sprayer. 4 stars because I hate recommending something after using it for only a month. Ask me again after 6 months or a year or two or seven. My last dishwasher (Bosch) only lasted 7 years.

Sentence (English): It's not my house, so I can't afford a built-in one, and since I'm a family of four, a 6-person dishwasher would be too small, so I didn't even think about it.
Comments (English): [ I should have bought it earlier ] || ---------------- || It's not my house, so I can't afford a built-in one, and since I'm a family of four, a 6-person dishwasher would be too small, so I didn't even think about it. But as I get older, I hate doing dishes so much. After reading reviews, I thought it was usable even for 6 people, so I bought it. There are pros and cons, but I'm satisfied. At first, I was going to go with SK, but they closed down the business, so I was worried and ended up going with Media. Many companies sell dishwashers that are OEM versions of Media's. I was concerned about the after-sales service, but if you sign up for Coupang's 2-year warranty and Ansim Care, you should be able to use it for a long time. I've decided to wash large pots and frying pans by hand, so I just put the rest in and run it, but it's much better than not having one. Above all, the automatic door opening is a must-have feature. The two-tier drying rack can be removed and used depending on the situation, and the stainless steel interior all the way to the ceiling is nice, as the water stream comes from the top, bottom, and sides for a more thorough wash. I was worried that there would be no hot air drying, but it dries quickly after use, so it's okay. However, the width of the cutlery drawer is the most disappointing. I installed the door facing the sink, but because I'm short, I can't put dishes in the cupboard. I didn't expect that it would be difficult to take it out, but it was good for putting the dishes in after the larvae hatched. We decided who would take turns doing the dishes after meals, and now my family has a lot more free time. I didn't use the drying rack I received when I replaced the sink because it was small, but I summoned it again because it can wash simple dishes even with a dishwasher. If you don't have one, you can buy a drying mat and use it together. The installer was kind and did a good job. I thought he wouldn't drill a hole because there was an existing water purifier, but he said that their policy had changed due to a water leak and drilled a hole. There are reviews from people who installed it around the same time that said they didn't drill a hole. As of 5/17, it's been 3 months and it's still working very well. Comments (English): [ I should have bought it earlier ] || ---------------- || It's not my house, so I can't afford a built-in one, and since I'm a family of four, a 6-person dishwasher would be too small, so I didn't even think about it. But as I get older, I hate doing dishes so much. After reading reviews, I thought it was usable even for 6 people, so I bought it. There are pros and cons, but I'm satisfied. At first, I was going to go with SK, but they closed down the business, so I was worried and ended up going with Media. Many companies sell dishwashers that are OEM versions of Media's. I was concerned about the after-sales service, but if you sign up for Coupang's 2-year warranty and Ansim Care, you should be able to use it for a long time. I've decided to wash large pots and frying pans by hand, so I just put the rest in and run it, but it's much better than not having one. Above all, the automatic door opening is a must-have feature. The two-tier drying rack can be removed and used depending on the situation, and the stainless steel interior all the way to the ceiling is nice, as the water stream comes from the top, bottom, and sides for a more thorough wash. I was worried that there would be no hot air drying, but it dries quickly after use, so it's okay. However, the width of the cutlery drawer is the most disappointing. I installed the door facing the sink, but because I'm short, I can't put dishes in the cupboard. I didn't expect that it would be difficult to take it out, but it was good for putting the dishes in after the larvae hatched. We decided who would take turns doing the dishes after meals, and now my family has a lot more free time. I didn't use the drying rack I received when I replaced the sink because it was small, but I summoned it again because it can wash simple dishes even with a dishwasher. If you don't have one, you can buy a drying mat and use it together. The installer was kind and did a good job. I thought he wouldn't drill a hole because there was an existing water purifier, but he said that their policy had changed due to a water leak and drilled a hole. There are reviews from people who installed it around the same time that said they didn't drill a hole. As of 5/17, it's been 3 months and it's still working very well. A few days ago, I got an E4 error when I turned it on, so I looked it up and it said it was a water leak message, but I couldn't find any leaks, and after turning the power on and off and checking the drain and inlet pipes, I'm so relieved that it's working normally. Would you believe me if I said I was scared that the dishwasher wouldn't work?

At first, I was going to go with SK, but they closed down the business, so I was worried and ended up going with Media. Many companies sell dishwashers that are OEM versions of Media's. I was concerned about the after-sales service, but if you sign up for Coupang's 2-year warranty and Ansim Care, you should be able to use it for a long time. I've decided to wash large pots and frying pans by hand, so I just put the rest in and run it, but it's much better than not having one. Above all, the automatic door opening is a must-have feature. The two-tier drying rack can be removed and used depending on the situation, and the stainless steel interior all the way to the ceiling is nice, as the water stream comes from the top, bottom, and sides for a more thorough wash. I was worried that there would be no hot air drying, but it dries quickly after use, so it's okay. However, the width of the cutlery drawer is the most disappointing. I installed the door facing the sink, but because I'm short, I can't put dishes in the cupboard. I didn't expect that it would be difficult to take it out, but it was good for putting the dishes in after the larvae hatched. We decided who would take turns doing the dishes after meals, and now my family has a lot more free time. I didn't use the drying rack I received when I replaced the sink because it was small, but I summoned it again because it can wash simple dishes even with a dishwasher. If you don't have one, you can buy a drying mat and use it together. The installer was kind and did a good job. I thought he wouldn't drill a hole because there was an existing water purifier, but he said that their policy had changed due to a water leak and drilled a hole. There are reviews from people who installed it around the same time that said they didn't drill a hole. As of 5/17, it's been 3 months and it's still working very well. A few days ago, I got an E4 error when I turned it on, so I looked it up and it said it was a water leak message, but I couldn't find any leaks, and after turning the power on and off and checking the drain and inlet pipes, I'm so relieved that it's working normally. Would you believe me if I said I was scared that the dishwasher wouldn't work?

But as I get older, I hate doing dishes so much. After reading reviews, I thought it was usable even for 6 people, so I bought it. There are pros and cons, but I'm satisfied. At first, I was going to go with SK, but they closed down the business, so I was worried and ended up going with Media. Many companies sell dishwashers that are OEM versions of Media's. I was concerned about the after-sales service, but if you sign up for Coupang's 2-year warranty and Ansim Care, you should be able to use it for a long time. I've decided to wash large pots and frying pans by hand, so I just put the rest in and run it, but it's much better than not having one. Above all, the automatic door opening is a must-have feature. The two-tier drying rack can be removed and used depending on the situation, and the stainless steel interior all the way to the ceiling is nice, as the water stream comes from the top, bottom, and sides for a more thorough wash. I was worried that there would be no hot air drying, but it dries quickly after use, so it's okay. However, the width of the cutlery drawer is the most disappointing. I installed the door facing the sink, but because I'm short, I can't put dishes in the cupboard. I didn't expect that it would be difficult to take it out, but it was good for putting the dishes in after the larvae hatched. We decided who would take turns doing the dishes after meals, and now my family has a lot more free time. I didn't use the drying rack I received when I replaced the sink because it was small, but I summoned it again because it can wash simple dishes even with a dishwasher. If you don't have one, you can buy a drying mat and use it together. The installer was kind and did a good job. I thought he wouldn't drill a hole because there was an existing water purifier, but he said that their policy had changed due to a water leak and drilled a hole. There are reviews from people who installed it around the same time that said they didn't drill a hole. As of 5/17, it's been 3 months and it's still working very well. A few days ago, I got an E4 error when I turned it on, so I looked it up and it said it was a water leak message, but I couldn't find any leaks, and after turning the power on and off and checking the drain and inlet pipes, I'm so relieved that it's working normally. Would you believe me if I said I was scared that the dishwasher wouldn't work?

The two-tier drying rack can be removed depending on the situation, and I like that the interior is stainless steel all the way to the ceiling. Actually, the narrow width of the cutlery holder is the most disappointing aspect. I had the door facing the sink, and since I am short, I didn't anticipate having to stand on tiptoe to take dishes out of the cupboard. I didn't use the drying rack I received when replacing the sink because it was too small, but since there are still simple dishes to wash even with the dishwasher, I have brought it out again and am using it. If you don't have one, it is a good idea to buy a drying mat to use together. The technician installed it kindly and did a great job. I thought they wouldn't drill a hole because we already had a water purifier, but they said their policy had changed regarding leaks and drilled a hole. There are reviews from people who had it installed around the same time saying they didn't have to drill a hole. As of May 17, it has been almost three months and I am using it very well. A few days ago, when I turned it on, an E4 error popped up. I looked it up and it was a leak message, but I couldn't find any leaks. I tried turning the power on and off and checked the drain and inlet pipes, and I was such a relief that it is working normally now. Sentence (English): My second aunt's dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ The second aunt is the dishwasher! Many people talk about whether it is a dryer or a dishwasher, but I don't think I really need a dishwasher. I have to do it all at once, soak it, separate the rice grains, etc. ] || ---------------- || My second aunt's dishwasher! Many people talk about a dryer or a dishwasher, but I didn't really need a dishwasher. I had to do it all at once, soak it, remove the rice, etc., and the most unpleasant feeling was the feeling of food scraps and dishes drying together, so I was reluctant. But my husband said he would buy it for me, so I got it and at first, I wasn't used to using it and couldn't stand seeing the dishes coming out one or two at a time, so I washed the dishes by hand a bit (I wondered why I bought it if it was going to be like this). Now that I've gotten the hang of it, I use it so conveniently. For now, I run it twice a day on weekends because it's really useful, and once in the afternoon on weekdays. Wow! I'm finally experiencing a new world when I run the dishwasher on things that were greased or had a smell. For oily pots, sometimes you have to wash them with detergent two or three times to get rid of the slippery parts, but with the dishwasher, it’s clean once you put it in and run it. When there are more than two pots and a lot of dishes coming out, to be honest, I often get a mental breakdown just trying to wash the dishes. Now, after rinsing, I just have to play Tetris well, so it’s so convenient. It also uses less water than washing dishes by hand, which is the best! Even if you don’t use hot air, stains, glass, and ceramics almost dry out, and plastic doesn’t dry as much as stainless steel. At first, I was worried about the electricity bill because I was going to run it for 2 or 3 hours at a time, but now I run it on the course I usually use and set it for 1 hour and 30 minutes to 2 hours. I experimented with different steps, such as adjusting the salt and rinse, and I’m washing the dishes cleanly in a way that suits my household. I’m satisfied.

We luckily did not have issues with installation as noted by several other customers. We also have not had it 6 mos even so can't speak to longevity yet.Cons:1) this is not a "heated dry" dishwasher. End result: all cups/containers with any divot/uneven surface are still wet if you don't angle them and play tetris just right so water doesn't get trapped. Angling them a certain way in rack 2 means losing space also for more cups/bowls. Even cracking open at the end of the cycle doesn't help. who likes wet cups and having to manually dry? We delay to avoid high electricity rates during peak hours and it's frustrating to find unclean dishes in the morning b/c your spouse or yourself snuck in another glass or two and forgot to hit "start" again3) there is no indicator for when to refill the rinse aid (eg, Jet dry). I have NEVER had a dishwasher not have a visual to help me know when the rinse aid is running low so I can add more. I just have to wing it or note when the glasses seem to streak. This is not hard to have built in! Find yourself a different glass front dishwasher and pass this one. This is by far, the worst dishwasher we've ever used/had. Samsung, don't bother responding back either, your response won't change my mind about anything.

Comments (Original): [ Confío en la marca ] || ---------------- || Es pronto para opinar sobre el funcionamiento,  pero el lavavajillas se ve robusto y de calidad, con una línea limpia y elegante,  intuitivo y fácil de instalar,  mis expectativas son altas!! Estéticamente me gusta mucho, el cuanto lleve una semana de uso reeditaré  la reseña. El servicio de entrega puntual y muy muy bien embalado, ni un rasguño ni nada que pueda objetar.  El precio, para la calidad que suelen tener los electrodomésticos de esta marca ha sido muy bueno.  Viene con tercera bandeja, es el primero que tengo con bandeja de cubiertos,  la bandeja de los platos tiene mucha amplitud y caben ollas y sartenes de gran tamaño, lo que facilita el lavado y ahorra tiempo y agua. Teclado retroiluminado en rojo visible en el frontal del aparato, no hay que abrir la puerta para ver los programas,  le da un toque moderno sin ser estridente para nada. Libro de instrucciones claro y en español, lo cual hoy en día es de agradecer. Es silencioso, apenas se escucha,  deja la vajilla impecable, aunque como dije es pronto para opinar sobre el funcionamiento ya que lo acabo de estrenar,  pero de momento llevo dos lavados y perfecto, deja todo limpio y seco.  Espero seguir teniendo esta opinión en incluso poder mejorarla con el uso continuado.  Tiene depósito de sal,  de abrillantador y trampilla para la pastilla de lavado, este último es quizás lo que menos me gusta,  como en casi todos los lavavajillas hay que darle dos o tres veces para que se quede cerrado, supongo que con la práctica le encontraré el punto para que se cierre a la primera, el depósito de abrillantador tiene bastante cabida. Suficientes programas para todo tipo de vajilla y cantidad de restos a eliminar,  yo he probado el corto, mi vajilla no estaba muy sucia y la dejó bien.  Se puede desactivar el abrillantador en caso de usar pastillas todo en uno,  lleva incorporado home connect, con lo que se puede conectar a la Red WiFi de casa. En fin de momento encantada con el juguete

Sentence (English): While this started out a great washer, it's gone down hill.
Comments (English): [ Started great. now I hate. ] || ---------------- || While this started out a great washer, it's gone down hill. At about 2 years 3 months (shortly after my costco warranty expired) the computer/board started to freak out. The lights would all flash, it would beep and chime randomly, and the buttons would blink. Customer Service said that it was likely because moisture had gotten into the door where the CPU/board is. They told us to let the machine dry out for a few days, which worked for a week or so. But, at the expense of having to handwash dishes for three days. I know, first world problems. But, when you spend over a grand on a dishwasher, you expect it to work for longer than two years. Remember the old whirlpools, etc. that lasted 20+ years? Well, now we're looking at having to buy another one. Are they all bad? Just LG? Just this model? Ugh.

We're fans of the brand, but wish this had been a better experience.

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace a broken Bosch dishwasher that was present when I bought my house.
Comments (English): [ Silent and effective ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace a broken Bosch dishwasher that was present when I bought my house. The inside tub is plastic, the door flies open if you don't hold onto it and lower it slowly. Likewise, the shelves are very lightweight and cheap feeling. They don't glide like my old ones did. I suppose it's unfair to compare the quality of these two dishwashers, so I will share what I DO like about it. 1) It is almost completely silent. I've had to check a few times to see if it was actually still running. 2) So far everything has come out squeaky clean even casserole pans that were not rinsed prior. 3) The third rack has been handy for items I usually don't put in the dishwasher - sponges, small delicate glass bowls, cooking utensils. Sentence (English): It's too early to comment on its operation, but the dishwasher looks sturdy and high-quality, with a clean, elegant design, intuitive operation, and easy installation.
Comments (English): [ I trust the brand ] || ---------------- || It's too early to comment on its operation, but the dishwasher looks sturdy and high-quality, with a clean, elegant design, intuitive operation, and easy installation. My expectations are high! Aesthetically, I really like it; once I've used it for a week, I'll republish this review. The delivery service was on time and very, very well packaged, with not a scratch or anything else to complain about. The price, considering the quality of this brand's appliances, was very good. It comes with a third shelf; it's the first one I've had with a cutlery tray. The dish rack is very spacious and fits large pots and pans, making washing easier and saving time and water. The red backlit keypad is visible on the front of the appliance; you don't have to open the door to view the programs. It gives it a modern touch without being too strident. The instruction manual is clear and in Spanish, which is appreciated these days. It's quiet, barely audible, and leaves the dishes spotless. As I said, it's too early to comment on how it works since I've just used it for the first time. So far, I've done two washes and it's perfect, leaving everything clean and dry. I hope to maintain this rating and even improve it with continued use. It has a salt and rinse aid reservoir, and a tab door. The latter is perhaps my least favorite. Like most dishwashers, you have to press it two or three times for it to close. I suppose with practice I'll find the way to close it the first time. The rinse aid reservoir has plenty of room. Enough programs for all types of dishes and the amount of residue to remove. I tried the short one; my dishes weren't very dirty, and it left them fine. You can deactivate the rinse aid if using all-in-one tabs. It has a built-in Home Connect feature, so you can connect it to your home Wi-Fi network. So far, I'm delighted with the toy.
Comments (Original): [ Confío en la marca ] || ---------------- || Es pronto para opinar sobre el funcionamiento,  pero el lavavajillas se ve robusto y de calidad, con una línea limpia y elegante,  intuitivo y fácil de instalar,  mis expectativas son altas!! Estéticamente me gusta mucho, el cuanto lleve una semana de uso reeditaré  la reseña. El servicio de entrega puntual y muy muy bien embalado, ni un rasguño ni nada que pueda objetar.  El precio, para la calidad que suelen tener los electrodomésticos de esta marca ha sido muy bueno.  Viene con tercera bandeja, es el primero que tengo con bandeja de cubiertos,  la bandeja de los platos tiene mucha amplitud y caben ollas y sartenes de gran tamaño, lo que facilita el lavado y ahorra tiempo y agua. Teclado retroiluminado en rojo visible en el frontal del aparato, no hay que abrir la puerta para ver los programas,  le da un toque moderno sin ser estridente para nada. Libro de instrucciones claro y en español, lo cual hoy en día es de agradecer. Es silencioso, apenas se escucha,  deja la vajilla impecable, aunque como dije es pronto para opinar sobre el funcionamiento ya que lo acabo de estrenar,  pero de momento llevo dos lavados y perfecto, deja todo limpio y seco.  Espero seguir teniendo esta opinión en incluso poder mejorarla con el uso continuado. Sentence (English): 10 years ago, when I first got married, I bought a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ It's dinner time after work. How long has it been since I've sat on the sofa and rested? ] || ---------------- || 10 years ago, when I first got married, I bought a dishwasher. I used it only twice or three times before throwing it away and I was a dishwasher boycotter. These days, it's vacation, so I have to pack lunches for the kids and the dishes that piled up in the lunch box were always stressful after work, but I just had to do it. I just gave up and thought I was doing a good job. Then one day, my second child... Mom hates washing dishes the most~~ I thought she didn't show it because she said she would make a dishwashing machine that wouldn't make things hard for her. I don't know why, but whenever I do dishes, all I think about are annoying things from the past, complaints, and all these miscellaneous thoughts, and I make it harder on myself. Why is that happening whenever I just do dishes? These days, dishwashers are different from the old ones~~ Dishwasher Auntie~ A new world of dishwashers~ I used to be a big distrustor of dishwashers because of my distrust of old ones, but when I went to Gmarket to buy a computer, there was a hot deal for a dishwasher. They installed it neatly and explained it well, and I was very satisfied with the appearance of the spacious 14-person, magnificent body, and neat beige color. When I turned it on in the evening, it was washed very cleanly. I now have time to sit on the sofa with the kids^^

After using it, I really like it because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I am tired. This was my honest review of my purchase with my own money. If it helped you in your purchase decision, please click the helpful button! Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review Product basic information Media automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher 6-person Color: White, Model name: (MDWMT0601W-WIN-KR) Window design Free A/S period 2-year free repair possible through Coupang customer center Friendly + fast delivery First of all, I paid with Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came and installed it the next day, Sunday. I was satisfied with the fast delivery that was installed in one day, and the installation technician was very friendly. Window design I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I decided on the window type. The reason was that it has a sense of openness, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function, but the price difference from the basic design model is only about 40,000 won. I decided to buy this after discussing it with my husband, thinking that I would use it for a long time once I bought it. Reasonable price After looking into it, I found out that various large companies were selling dishwasher products manufactured by Media. When I found out that it was being sold at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs, I wondered if it was really worth buying it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by the low noise. Since it is a type that is placed on the sink, I expected it to be very noisy. But by my standards, the noise was really quiet. It is suitable for use in a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher is that I am 7 months pregnant, so now my back, pelvis, stomach, and knees hurt even when I am still because of the weight of my belly. So I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as standing up and washing dishes. After using it, I really like it because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I am tired. And soon, when the baby is born, we will be a family of three, and since we eat home-cooked meals more than eating out, I thought that if the dishwasher could wash the dishes and bottles better than I could, my quality of life would improve. After using it, I was very satisfied because I didn’t have to wait for the dishwashing to finish and manually open the door thanks to the automatic door opening function. The glass cups looked clearer than the ones I washed! I cleaned the dishes three times in every corner, top/middle/bottom, so if I played Tetris well, there was no place that was not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of the dishwasher-specific liquid detergent for the Nature Pong dishwasher can be used to wash not only regular dishes but also baby bottles, and it has good reviews for its 3x more upgraded cleaning power. But since most 6-person dishwashers do that, I will understand and move on. The dishwasher releases heat with the smart auto-open function, and the dishes dry after a while. I didn’t have to dry them one by one when I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so there’s no need to worry. This was a big merit that played a part in my decision. This was my honest review of my purchase with my own money. If it helped you in your purchase decision, please click the helpful button! I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher to improve your quality of life!

Comments (English): My money, my country / Media 6-person dishwasher review Product basic information Media automatic door opening UV lamp dishwasher 6-person Color: White, Model name: (MDWMT0601W-WIN-KR) Window design Free A/S period 2-year free repair possible through Coupang customer center Friendly + fast delivery First of all, I paid with Coupang Rocket Delivery, and the technician came and installed it the next day, Sunday. Window design I was originally considering the basic design of the Media dishwasher, but I decided on the window type. The reason was that it has a sense of openness, a prettier design, and an added UV sterilization function, but the price difference from the basic design model is only about 40,000 won. I decided to buy this after discussing it with my husband, thinking that I would use it for a long time once I bought it. Reasonable price After looking into it, I found out that various large companies were selling dishwasher products manufactured by Media. When I found out that it was being sold at a higher price with slightly different labels and designs, I wondered if it was really worth buying it at a higher price. So I searched for media and found out that Coupang officially imported it and provided 2 years of free A/S, so I bought it. When I tried the low-noise dishwasher, it was quieter than I thought. Honestly, I was surprised by the low noise. Since it is a type that is placed on the sink, I expected it to be very noisy. But by my standards, the noise was really quiet. It is suitable for use in a house with a baby. Cleaning power + convenience The decisive reason I bought the dishwasher is that I am 7 months pregnant, so now my back, pelvis, stomach, and knees hurt even when I am still because of the weight of my belly. So I bought it to reduce the time I spend doing housework, such as standing up and washing dishes. After using it, I really like it because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I am tired. And soon, when the baby is born, we will be a family of three, and since we eat home-cooked meals more than eating out, I thought that if the dishwasher could wash the dishes and bottles better than I could, my quality of life would improve. After using it, I was very satisfied because I didn’t have to wait for the dishwashing to finish and manually open the door thanks to the automatic door opening function. The glass cups looked clearer than the ones I washed! I cleaned the dishes three times in every corner, top/middle/bottom, so if I played Tetris well, there was no place that was not cleaned. I searched on Coupang and bought some eco-friendly liquid detergent in advance and poured it in. The latest version of the dishwasher-specific liquid detergent for the Nature Pong dishwasher can be used to wash not only regular dishes but also baby bottles, and it has good reviews for its 3x more upgraded cleaning power. But since most 6-person dishwashers do that, I will understand and move on. The dishwasher releases heat with the smart auto-open function, and the dishes dry after a while. I didn’t have to dry them one by one when I washed them by hand. And this product has a stainless steel top, so there’s no need to worry. This was a big merit that played a part in my decision. This was my honest review of my purchase with my own money. If it helped you in your purchase decision, please click the helpful button! I highly recommend the Media Dishwasher to improve your quality of life!

After using it, I really like it because I can do other things during the dishwashing time or take a break when I am tired. He told me to open it in the middle of the cycle and put it in, but if that's the case, why am I using it? I can't use it like that, so I asked for a refund. When I heard this, the LG service center said that they were just blaming us and that it was never actually done. The 12-person ones are all coated, but why are the 6-person ones just plain old? They sell them so expensively and put full stainless steel on them. 10 years ago? The 6-person dishwasher that was released was just a refurbished version, but it fits perfectly. I guess they put in a touch panel when it was released without any upgrades and called it a new product. The 2nd stage is too narrow to use. I removed the 2nd stage and just use it as the 1st stage. There is no use for the 2nd basket and it is just a burden. This was the dishwasher that really disappointed me the most with LG products in a long time. They said that if you want to experience the dishwasher performance properly, you have to use the 12-person one. They said that not many people use the 6-person one (according to the repairman). So, if I return it and pay more money, will you change it to a 12-person one? If no one uses it, why are you selling the 6-person one? The review has become too long. I tried to shorten it, but it is not easy. I have a lot to say, but I will not say any more. I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. This is my honest review of what I paid for myself! I hope it will be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. Thank you! Have a nice day!

I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. It was as if I had been to a salt field, and there were white water stains all over the glassware, the stand bowl, the lid, the pot, the spoon, and the chopsticks. I took them all out, soaked them one by one, and wiped them again, and I cursed out loud. 2. What does AS mean? I called the customer service center right away and filed a complaint. I bought it yesterday and ran it for the first time, changed the detergent, and ran it, and even did the full-cleaning that the customer service center told me to do with citric acid. He told me to open it in the middle of the cycle and put it in, but if that's the case, why am I using it? I can't use it like that, so I asked for a refund. LG said that a return is only accepted if there is a clear machine problem \"proven\". And only if the same symptoms occur after replacing the same part 3 times. I was so angry that I contacted Coupang Customer Service. If it is found to be defective within 3 months of purchase, Coupang can collect it and issue a refund. When I heard this, the LG service center said that they were just blaming us and that it was never actually done. The 12-person ones are all coated, but why are the 6-person ones just plain old? They sell them so expensively and put full stainless steel on them. 10 years ago? The 6-person dishwasher that was released was just a refurbished version, but it fits perfectly. I guess they put in a touch panel when it was released without any upgrades and called it a new product. The 2nd stage is too narrow to use. I removed the 2nd stage and just use it as the 1st stage. There is no use for the 2nd basket and it is just a burden. This was the dishwasher that really disappointed me the most with LG products in a long time. They said that if you want to experience the dishwasher performance properly, you have to use the 12-person one. They said that not many people use the 6-person one (according to the repairman). So, if I return it and pay more money, will you change it to a 12-person one? If no one uses it, why are you selling the 6-person one? The review has become too long. I tried to shorten it, but it is not easy. I have a lot to say, but I will not say any more. I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. This is my honest review of what I paid for myself! I hope it will be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. Thank you! Have a nice day!

I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. You know that you should never buy something you spend your money on carelessly, right? :) Where should I start and where should I end this product? I'm worried that it will be too long, but I'll try to write only the most important points (seriously). First, the reasons I chose the LG dishwasher are as follows. 1. Domestic production 2. The last product I compared was Samsung. I have many Samsung appliances at home and I was satisfied with them, so I was a little less inclined to think that LG is the best for appliances. However, the reason I dropped out in the end was that it was bigger, so it was less convenient to use kitchen space than LG, and although it is full stainless steel, it is a bit lacking because it is made in China. Oh, and the UV sterilization and high temperature are a little disappointing compared to LG. The conclusion? Well. I haven't compared it with Samsung's, but I think I should have gone with Samsung, even though it is a bit bigger and made in China. If I were to turn back time and buy the dishwasher again, I would probably do the same. After installing the dishwasher, I was frustrated for almost a month, but now I'm in a situation where I can't do anything, so I'll just. Use it. I'm satisfied with not having to wash dishes. Reason for 2 stars (not so much) - Please note that this is my extremely personal opinion. 1. There are so many water stains that I wonder if this is it. As soon as I installed it, I put in all the dishes I had collected and bought a detergent that was supposed to be good and ran it. When I finished it with excitement and opened it, what is this? It was as if I had been to a salt field, and there were white water stains all over the glassware, the stand bowl, the lid, the pot, the spoon, and the chopsticks. I took them all out, soaked them one by one, and wiped them again, and I cursed out loud. 2. What does AS mean? I called the customer service center right away and filed a complaint. I bought it yesterday and ran it for the first time, changed the detergent, and ran it, and even did the full-cleaning that the customer service center told me to do with citric acid. Isn't it funny that I'm doing a full-cleaning on a new product? Even after washing and running it again, the water stains are still the same. The repairman came. He tested the pH of the water in my house. It's within the normal range. He told me to change the detergent. To Frosch. And he told me to put in 1/4. He showed me all the detergents I had, including Frosch, and said that he had already put in 1/4 and tried everything. In the end, he said that since the dishwasher is mainly for 12 people, the 6-person one does not have a water softener function and there is no rinse container, so water stains are inevitable. He said that this is normal. The dishwasher washes the dishes, but it doesn't wash them properly and doesn't have that function. He told me to use rinse, but there is no rinse container at all. He told me to open it in the middle of the cycle and put it in, but if that's the case, why am I using it? I can't use it like that, so I asked for a refund. LG said that a return is only accepted if there is a clear machine problem \"proven\". And only if the same symptoms occur after replacing the same part 3 times. I was so angry that I contacted Coupang Customer Service. If it is found to be defective within 3 months of purchase, Coupang can collect it and issue a refund. When I heard this, the LG service center said that they were just blaming us and that it was never actually done. They said that it was just an evasive manual and that there was no such thing as a defective product. Isn't the biggest reason to trust the AS of large companies? I really wanted to throw it away. I thought for a long time whether I should buy it again or not, but. I thought I was putting my feelings into something for 1 dollar, so I just gave up and used it roughly. Actually, I was going to filter it out after watching the YouTuber Guigom's channel, but I chose it because it's LG. It's a domestic product, so I thought the basic performance would be good, but it's not full stainless steel, the door doesn't open, the water flows, and the basket isn't coated, so the coating on the pot and frying pan is all peeling off? The 12-person ones are all coated, but why are the 6-person ones just plain old? They sell them so expensively and put full stainless steel on them. 10 years ago? The 6-person dishwasher that was released was just a refurbished version, but it fits perfectly. I guess they put in a touch panel when it was released without any upgrades and called it a new product. The 2nd stage is too narrow to use. I removed the 2nd stage and just use it as the 1st stage. There is no use for the 2nd basket and it is just a burden. This was the dishwasher that really disappointed me the most with LG products in a long time. They said that if you want to experience the dishwasher performance properly, you have to use the 12-person one. They said that not many people use the 6-person one (according to the repairman). So, if I return it and pay more money, will you change it to a 12-person one? If no one uses it, why are you selling the 6-person one? The review has become too long. I tried to shorten it, but it is not easy. I have a lot to say, but I will not say any more. I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. This is my honest review of what I paid for myself! I hope it will be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. Thank you! Have a nice day!

I haven't compared it with Samsung's, but I think I should have gone with Samsung, even though it is a bit bigger and made in China. If I were to turn back time and buy the dishwasher again, I would probably do the same. After installing the dishwasher, I was frustrated for almost a month, but now I'm in a situation where I can't do anything, so I'll just. Use it. I'm satisfied with not having to wash dishes. Reason for 2 stars (not so much) - Please note that this is my extremely personal opinion. 1. There are so many water stains that I wonder if this is it. As soon as I installed it, I put in all the dishes I had collected and bought a detergent that was supposed to be good and ran it. When I finished it with excitement and opened it, what is this? It was as if I had been to a salt field, and there were white water stains all over the glassware, the stand bowl, the lid, the pot, the spoon, and the chopsticks. I took them all out, soaked them one by one, and wiped them again, and I cursed out loud. 2. What does AS mean? I called the customer service center right away and filed a complaint. I bought it yesterday and ran it for the first time, changed the detergent, and ran it, and even did the full-cleaning that the customer service center told me to do with citric acid. Isn't it funny that I'm doing a full-cleaning on a new product? Even after washing and running it again, the water stains are still the same. The repairman came. He tested the pH of the water in my house. It's within the normal range. He told me to change the detergent. To Frosch. And he told me to put in 1/4. He showed me all the detergents I had, including Frosch, and said that he had already put in 1/4 and tried everything. In the end, he said that since the dishwasher is mainly for 12 people, the 6-person one does not have a water softener function and there is no rinse container, so water stains are inevitable. He said that this is normal. The dishwasher washes the dishes, but it doesn't wash them properly and doesn't have that function. He told me to use rinse, but there is no rinse container at all. He told me to open it in the middle of the cycle and put it in, but if that's the case, why am I using it? I can't use it like that, so I asked for a refund. LG said that a return is only accepted if there is a clear machine problem \"proven\". And only if the same symptoms occur after replacing the same part 3 times. I was so angry that I contacted Coupang Customer Service. If it is found to be defective within 3 months of purchase, Coupang can collect it and issue a refund. When I heard this, the LG service center said that they were just blaming us and that it was never actually done. They said that it was just an evasive manual and that there was no such thing as a defective product. Isn't the biggest reason to trust the AS of large companies? I really wanted to throw it away. I thought for a long time whether I should buy it again or not, but. I thought I was putting my feelings into something for 1 dollar, so I just gave up and used it roughly. Actually, I was going to filter it out after watching the YouTuber Guigom's channel, but I chose it because it's LG. It's a domestic product, so I thought the basic performance would be good, but it's not full stainless steel, the door doesn't open, the water flows, and the basket isn't coated, so the coating on the pot and frying pan is all peeling off? The 12-person ones are all coated, but why are the 6-person ones just plain old? They sell them so expensively and put full stainless steel on them. 10 years ago? The 6-person dishwasher that was released was just a refurbished version, but it fits perfectly. I guess they put in a touch panel when it was released without any upgrades and called it a new product. The 2nd stage is too narrow to use. I removed the 2nd stage and just use it as the 1st stage. There is no use for the 2nd basket and it is just a burden. This was the dishwasher that really disappointed me the most with LG products in a long time. They said that if you want to experience the dishwasher performance properly, you have to use the 12-person one. They said that not many people use the 6-person one (according to the repairman). So, if I return it and pay more money, will you change it to a 12-person one? If no one uses it, why are you selling the 6-person one? The review has become too long. I tried to shorten it, but it is not easy. I have a lot to say, but I will not say any more. I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. This is my honest review of what I paid for myself! I hope it will be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. Thank you! Have a nice day!

I haven't compared it with Samsung's, but I think I should have gone with Samsung, even though it is a bit bigger and made in China. If I were to turn back time and buy the dishwasher again, I would probably do the same. After installing the dishwasher, I was frustrated for almost a month, but now I'm in a situation where I can't do anything, so I'll just. Use it. I'm satisfied with not having to wash dishes. Reason for 2 stars (not so much) - Please note that this is my extremely personal opinion. 1. There are so many water stains that I wonder if this is it. As soon as I installed it, I put in all the dishes I had collected and bought a detergent that was supposed to be good and ran it. When I finished it with excitement and opened it, what is this? It was as if I had been to a salt field, and there were white water stains all over the glassware, the stand bowl, the lid, the pot, the spoon, and the chopsticks. I took them all out, soaked them one by one, and wiped them again, and I cursed out loud. 2. What does AS mean? I called the customer service center right away and filed a complaint. I bought it yesterday and ran it for the first time, changed the detergent, and ran it, and even did the full-cleaning that the customer service center told me to do with citric acid. Isn't it funny that I'm doing a full-cleaning on a new product? Even after washing and running it again, the water stains are still the same. The repairman came. He tested the pH of the water in my house. It's within the normal range. He told me to change the detergent. To Frosch. And he told me to put in 1/4. He showed me all the detergents I had, including Frosch, and said that he had already put in 1/4 and tried everything. In the end, he said that since the dishwasher is mainly for 12 people, the 6-person one does not have a water softener function and there is no rinse container, so water stains are inevitable. He said that this is normal. The dishwasher washes the dishes, but it doesn't wash them properly and doesn't have that function. He told me to use rinse, but there is no rinse container at all. He told me to open it in the middle of the cycle and put it in, but if that's the case, why am I using it? I can't use it like that, so I asked for a refund. LG said that a return is only accepted if there is a clear machine problem \"proven\". And only if the same symptoms occur after replacing the same part 3 times. I was so angry that I contacted Coupang Customer Service. If it is found to be defective within 3 months of purchase, Coupang can collect it and issue a refund. When I heard this, the LG service center said that they were just blaming us and that it was never actually done. They said that it was just an evasive manual and that there was no such thing as a defective product. Isn't the biggest reason to trust the AS of large companies? I really wanted to throw it away. I thought for a long time whether I should buy it again or not, but. I thought I was putting my feelings into something for 1 dollar, so I just gave up and used it roughly. Actually, I was going to filter it out after watching the YouTuber Guigom's channel, but I chose it because it's LG. It's a domestic product, so I thought the basic performance would be good, but it's not full stainless steel, the door doesn't open, the water flows, and the basket isn't coated, so the coating on the pot and frying pan is all peeling off? The 12-person ones are all coated, but why are the 6-person ones just plain old? They sell them so expensively and put full stainless steel on them. 10 years ago? The 6-person dishwasher that was released was just a refurbished version, but it fits perfectly. I guess they put in a touch panel when it was released without any upgrades and called it a new product. The 2nd stage is too narrow to use. I removed the 2nd stage and just use it as the 1st stage. There is no use for the 2nd basket and it is just a burden. This was the dishwasher that really disappointed me the most with LG products in a long time. They said that if you want to experience the dishwasher performance properly, you have to use the 12-person one. They said that not many people use the 6-person one (according to the repairman). So, if I return it and pay more money, will you change it to a 12-person one? If no one uses it, why are you selling the 6-person one? The review has become too long. I tried to shorten it, but it is not easy. I have a lot to say, but I will not say any more. I do not know about the performance, but if they had handled the after-sales service well, I think it would not have been this bad. There must be other users who use it without any problems, so please refer to this again as this is my personal experience. LG is 12-person! That's why I can't recommend a 6-person model. This is my honest review of what I paid for myself! I hope it will be helpful to those who are considering purchasing. Thank you! Have a nice day!

At first, I was confused because there were people who brought dishes in between, but it was good that there was an additional function. - The automatic door open function was also really good. Noise Although it is an appliance that cannot be free of noise, I don't think it was uncomfortable for me. I usually operate the dishwasher when I am cleaning or going out and do other things, so I didn't care. Since my cats aren't really surprised, I think this level of noise is okay! And I think the noise level varies depending on the amount of dishes or how you organize and put them in the basket! AS Since it is not a brand that everyone knows, such as Sam* or L*, you might be worried about the AS. This product is covered by a 24-month free AS from Coupang! And it seems like I use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running~ and above all, because the dishes are washed well~~ I can protect my hands that are getting wrinkled and old~~ and I only need to put in one tablet of detergent. Most of the dishes that come out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it is convenient and nice that I can use them without buying new ones for dishwashers. At first, I was confused because there were people who brought dishes in between, but it was good that there was an additional function. - The automatic door open function was also really good. I turned on the dishwasher, did my work, went out, and reported my work, and the door automatically opened after it was finished, so it was sure to dry. - You can use it by linking it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I really use this? I thought about it~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it often~ When children who are not good at operating it or people at home put dishes in the dishwasher, I can operate it from outside, so when I come home from work, voila~~ the dishes are done! Noise Although it is an appliance that cannot be free of noise, I don't think it was uncomfortable for me. I usually operate the dishwasher when I am cleaning or going out and do other things, so I didn't care. Since my cats aren't really surprised, I think this level of noise is okay! And I think the noise level varies depending on the amount of dishes or how you organize and put them in the basket! AS Since it is not a brand that everyone knows, such as Sam* or L*, you might be worried about the AS. This product is covered by a 24-month free AS from Coupang! I can even get it repaired by applying to Coupang~ It is so convenient, worry-free, and seems like the best service. Overall review Media The dishwasher is my right arm! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have enough time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running~ and above all, because the dishes are washed well~~ I can protect my hands that are getting wrinkled and old~~ and I only need to put in one tablet of detergent. Since I used to wash the dishes full of oil with a lot of detergent, I was able to save that too, which was great! Since it is a 6-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of 4, so it was spacious and good~ It was also enough to accommodate guests! Most of the dishes that come out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it is convenient and nice that I can use them without buying new ones for dishwashers. Most of the dishes that come out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it is convenient and nice that I can use them without buying new ones for dishwashers. Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to purchase it. Thank you so much. I'll write a review after using it for a week. It was delivered through Rocket Delivery and Installation, so the installer personally brought it to me. It arrived without any damage. Installation: Since our house doesn't use a water purifier, I drilled a hole in the sink top and installed it. I didn't want a hole in the top, but the hole is as small as a hose, so it's not that noticeable. I installed it next to the sink bowl, so the hole or hose isn't visible. There's no outlet where I installed it, so I need a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have neatly attached it, but they didn't. The installation was neat and friendly. The functions are in the following order: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High Temperature Wash -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote Control -> Wi-Fi -> Add Dry -> Auto Door Open -> Reservation -> Cancel, Play. The operation buttons are electronic touch buttons, so they're easy to touch. You can refer to the manual for instructions, but it's easy to operate even without reading it. It's easy, and it has Wi-Fi so you can control it with your phone. Cleaning power: I put everything in it, including oily frying pans and dishes, and it all came out clean, and it was cleaner than when I wash the dishes myself. Especially after eating fish, the dishes have a terrible fishy smell, but there wasn't even a single fishy smell. Before washing the dishes, I first removed the food stuck to the dishes and put them in. If you don't remove it, it will remain in the dishwasher mesh, which is more of a hassle to remove. Also, if you put cheese stuck to the pan or something stuck to the surface right away, it won't be completely washed. I recommend soaking it in water before putting it in. Auto door opening: Many 6-person dishwashers don't have an auto door opening function, but this one has one, which is great. Both of us work, so we eat in the morning, put the dishwasher in, run it, go to work, run the dishwasher in the evening, and go to sleep. If there wasn't an auto door opening function, we would only use it on the weekends, use it all at once in the evening, and have to wait until it's done. The auto door opening is the best. They say a 6-person dishwasher is a waste of money. It would be nice to have a 12-person or more landfill, but in my house, I tend to make side dishes in bulk, so there aren't many dishes on weekdays. There are only a few dishes, but I didn't buy it because I thought it would be burdensome to run the dishwasher for more than 12 people, but after using the dishwasher for 6 people, it seems perfect. I think it's perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and people who eat out instead of cooking. And since it's a size that can fit a frying pan, I tried washing dishes by putting in 2 frying pans and 1 pot, and it washed well. If I learn the technique of loading dishes in the dishwasher, I think I'll be able to put in a lot of dishes. I don't have the technique yet, so I can't put more in even though I could. As you can see in the picture, I put in a lot of dishes. I think I have to get used to this as I use it. The moment I use the dishwasher, my quality of life improves and the burden of using dishes is reduced. I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to purchase it. Thank you so much. I'll write a review after using it for a week. It was delivered through Rocket Delivery and Installation, so the installer personally brought it to me. It arrived without any damage. Installation: Since our house doesn't use a water purifier, I drilled a hole in the sink top and installed it. I didn't want a hole in the top, but the hole is as small as a hose, so it's not that noticeable. I installed it next to the sink bowl, so the hole or hose isn't visible. There's no outlet where I installed it, so I need a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have neatly attached it, but they didn't. The installation was neat and friendly. The functions are in the following order: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High Temperature Wash -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote Control -> Wi-Fi -> Add Dry -> Auto Door Open -> Reservation -> Cancel, Play. The operation buttons are electronic touch buttons, so they're easy to touch. You can refer to the manual for instructions, but it's easy to operate even without reading it. It's easy, and it has Wi-Fi so you can control it with your phone. Cleaning power: I put everything in it, including oily frying pans and dishes, and it all came out clean, and it was cleaner than when I wash the dishes myself. Especially after eating fish, the dishes have a terrible fishy smell, but there wasn't even a single fishy smell. Before washing the dishes, I first removed the food stuck to the dishes and put them in. If you don't remove it, it will remain in the dishwasher mesh, which is more of a hassle to remove. Also, if you put cheese stuck to the pan or something stuck to the surface right away, it won't be completely washed. I recommend soaking it in water before putting it in. Auto door opening: Many 6-person dishwashers don't have an auto door opening function, but this one has one, which is great. Both of us work, so we eat in the morning, put the dishwasher in, run it, go to work, run the dishwasher in the evening, and go to sleep. If there wasn't an auto door opening function, we would only use it on the weekends, use it all at once in the evening, and have to wait until it's done. The auto door opening is the best. They say a 6-person dishwasher is a waste of money. It would be nice to have a 12-person or more landfill, but in my house, I tend to make side dishes in bulk, so there aren't many dishes on weekdays. There are only a few dishes, but I didn't buy it because I thought it would be burdensome to run the dishwasher for more than 12 people, but after using the dishwasher for 6 people, it seems perfect. I think it's perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and people who eat out instead of cooking. And since it's a size that can fit a frying pan, I tried washing dishes by putting in 2 frying pans and 1 pot, and it washed well. If I learn the technique of loading dishes in the dishwasher, I think I'll be able to put in a lot of dishes. I don't have the technique yet, so I can't put more in even though I could. As you can see in the picture, I put in a lot of dishes. I think I have to get used to this as I use it. The moment I use the dishwasher, my quality of life improves and the burden of using dishes is reduced. I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to purchase one. There's no outlet where I installed it, so I needed a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have installed it neatly, but they didn't. The installation was neat and friendly. Functions: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High Temperature -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote Control -> Wi-Fi -> Add Dry -> Auto Door Open -> Schedule -> Cancel, Play. The control buttons are electronic touch-sensitive, making them easy to use. You can read the instructions in the manual, but it's very easy to use even without them. I used it to wash everything, including greasy frying pans and dishes, and it cleaned everything better than when I wash dishes myself. I recommend soaking it in water before putting it in. Auto-open door. Most 6-person dishwashers don't have auto-open doors, but this one has one, which is great. Without the auto-open door, I would only use it on weekends, and then have to wait for it to finish. The auto-open door is the best. It's a 6-person dishwasher. We only have a few dishes, but I didn't buy one because I thought it would be burdensome to run the dishwasher for more than 12 people. But after using the 6-person dishwasher, I found it to be perfect. It seems perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and those who eat out rather than cook. It's also big enough to fit a frying pan, so I tried washing dishes with two frying pans and one pot. They washed well. Once I master the dishwasher loading technique, I think I'll be able to load more dishes. I'm still lacking the skill, so I can't fit more dishes even though I could. As you can see in the photo, I can see a lot of dishes being loaded. I think I need to get used to it as I use it. The moment I started using the dishwasher, my quality of life improved and the burden of using dishes decreased. I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): Cleaning power.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to purchase one. I didn't want a hole in the top, but it's small enough to be noticeable. I installed it next to the sink bowl, so neither the hole nor the water hose are visible. There's no outlet where I installed it, so I needed a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have installed it neatly, but they didn't. The installation was neat and friendly. Functions: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High Temperature -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote Control -> Wi-Fi -> Add Dry -> Auto Door Open -> Schedule -> Cancel, Play. The control buttons are electronic touch-sensitive, making them easy to use. You can read the instructions in the manual, but it's very easy to use even without them. And since it has Wi-Fi, you can control it with your phone. Cleaning power. I used it to wash everything, including greasy frying pans and dishes, and it cleaned everything better than when I wash dishes myself. Especially after eating fish, the dishes have a terrible fishy smell, but this one didn't smell at all. Before washing the dishes, I first removed any food stuck to the dishes before putting them in. If I didn't, it would stay in the dishwasher mesh, which was a hassle to remove. Also, if I put cheese or anything stuck to the pot right away, it wouldn't be completely washed. I recommend soaking it in water before putting it in. Auto-open door. Most 6-person dishwashers don't have auto-open doors, but this one has one, which is great. Both of us work, so we cook in the morning, put the dishwasher in, go to work, run the dishwasher in the evening, and then go to bed. Without the auto-open door, I would only use it on weekends, and then have to wait for it to finish. The auto-open door is the best. It's a 6-person dishwasher. They say a dishwasher is a waste of space. It would be nice to have one for 12 or more people, but since we tend to cook side dishes in batches, we don't get many dishes on weekdays. We only have a few dishes, but I didn't buy one because I thought it would be burdensome to run the dishwasher for more than 12 people. But after using the 6-person dishwasher, I found it to be perfect. It seems perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and those who eat out rather than cook. It's also big enough to fit a frying pan, so I tried washing dishes with two frying pans and one pot. They washed well. Once I master the dishwasher loading technique, I think I'll be able to load more dishes. I'm still lacking the skill, so I can't fit more dishes even though I could. As you can see in the photo, I can see a lot of dishes being loaded. I think I need to get used to it as I use it. The moment I started using the dishwasher, my quality of life improved and the burden of using dishes decreased. I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): Most 6-person dishwashers don't have auto-open doors, but this one has one, which is great.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to purchase one. Thank you so much. I'll use it for a week and write a review. Delivery: Since it was delivered via Rocket Delivery and Installation, the installer personally brought it out. It arrived without any damage. Installation: Since we don't use a water purifier, I drilled a hole in the sink top and installed it. I didn't want a hole in the top, but it's small enough to be noticeable. I installed it next to the sink bowl, so neither the hole nor the water hose are visible. There's no outlet where I installed it, so I needed a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have installed it neatly, but they didn't. The installation was neat and friendly. Functions: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High Temperature -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote Control -> Wi-Fi -> Add Dry -> Auto Door Open -> Schedule -> Cancel, Play. The control buttons are electronic touch-sensitive, making them easy to use. You can read the instructions in the manual, but it's very easy to use even without them. And since it has Wi-Fi, you can control it with your phone. Cleaning power. I used it to wash everything, including greasy frying pans and dishes, and it cleaned everything better than when I wash dishes myself. Especially after eating fish, the dishes have a terrible fishy smell, but this one didn't smell at all. Before washing the dishes, I first removed any food stuck to the dishes before putting them in. If I didn't, it would stay in the dishwasher mesh, which was a hassle to remove. Also, if I put cheese or anything stuck to the pot right away, it wouldn't be completely washed. I recommend soaking it in water before putting it in. Auto-open door. Most 6-person dishwashers don't have auto-open doors, but this one has one, which is great. Both of us work, so we cook in the morning, put the dishwasher in, go to work, run the dishwasher in the evening, and then go to bed. Without the auto-open door, I would only use it on weekends, and then have to wait for it to finish. The auto-open door is the best. It's a 6-person dishwasher. They say a dishwasher is a waste of space. It would be nice to have one for 12 or more people, but since we tend to cook side dishes in batches, we don't get many dishes on weekdays. We only have a few dishes, but I didn't buy one because I thought it would be burdensome to run the dishwasher for more than 12 people. But after using the 6-person dishwasher, I found it to be perfect. It seems perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and those who eat out rather than cook. It's also big enough to fit a frying pan, so I tried washing dishes with two frying pans and one pot. They washed well. Once I master the dishwasher loading technique, I think I'll be able to load more dishes. I'm still lacking the skill, so I can't fit more dishes even though I could. As you can see in the photo, I can see a lot of dishes being loaded. I think I need to get used to it as I use it. The moment I started using the dishwasher, my quality of life improved and the burden of using dishes decreased. I highly recommend it.

The moment I started using the dishwasher, my quality of life improved and the burden of using dishes decreased. I highly recommend it.

The moment I started using the dishwasher, my quality of life improved and the burden of using dishes decreased. I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): I highly recommend it.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I needed a dishwasher, and this was a great opportunity to purchase one. Thank you so much. I'll use it for a week and write a review. Delivery: Since it was delivered via Rocket Delivery and Installation, the installer personally brought it out. It arrived without any damage. Installation: Since we don't use a water purifier, I drilled a hole in the sink top and installed it. I didn't want a hole in the top, but it's small enough to be noticeable. I installed it next to the sink bowl, so neither the hole nor the water hose are visible. There's no outlet where I installed it, so I needed a multi-cord. If I had purchased a multi-cord in advance, they would have installed it neatly, but they didn't. The installation was neat and friendly. Functions: Power -> Auto -> Standard -> Power -> High Temperature -> Rapid -> Time -> Remote Control -> Wi-Fi -> Add Dry -> Auto Door Open -> Schedule -> Cancel, Play. The control buttons are electronic touch-sensitive, making them easy to use. You can read the instructions in the manual, but it's very easy to use even without them. And since it has Wi-Fi, you can control it with your phone. Cleaning power. I used it to wash everything, including greasy frying pans and dishes, and it cleaned everything better than when I wash dishes myself. Especially after eating fish, the dishes have a terrible fishy smell, but this one didn't smell at all. Before washing the dishes, I first removed any food stuck to the dishes before putting them in. If I didn't, it would stay in the dishwasher mesh, which was a hassle to remove. Also, if I put cheese or anything stuck to the pot right away, it wouldn't be completely washed. I recommend soaking it in water before putting it in. Auto-open door. Most 6-person dishwashers don't have auto-open doors, but this one has one, which is great. Both of us work, so we cook in the morning, put the dishwasher in, go to work, run the dishwasher in the evening, and then go to bed. Without the auto-open door, I would only use it on weekends, and then have to wait for it to finish. The auto-open door is the best. It's a 6-person dishwasher. They say a dishwasher is a waste of space. It would be nice to have one for 12 or more people, but since we tend to cook side dishes in batches, we don't get many dishes on weekdays. We only have a few dishes, but I didn't buy one because I thought it would be burdensome to run the dishwasher for more than 12 people. But after using the 6-person dishwasher, I found it to be perfect. It seems perfect for people living alone, newlyweds, and those who eat out rather than cook. It's also big enough to fit a frying pan, so I tried washing dishes with two frying pans and one pot. They washed well. Once I master the dishwasher loading technique, I think I'll be able to load more dishes. I'm still lacking the skill, so I can't fit more dishes even though I could. As you can see in the photo, I can see a lot of dishes being loaded. I think I need to get used to it as I use it. The moment I started using the dishwasher, my quality of life improved and the burden of using dishes decreased. I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): We are a two-person household that will soon be three.
Comments (English): [ We are a family of two soon to be three. First of all, there are many other dishwashers, so why did you choose this one? All of our home appliances are Samsung (although our cell phones are iPhones). So we bought the Samsung Smart Things app. ] || ---------------- || We are a two-person household that will soon be three. First of all, there are many other dishwashers, so why did you choose this one? Since all the home appliances in my house are Samsung (although my phone is an iPhone), I chose the Samsung brand because I use the Samsung Smart Things app. This model is a 14-person model with hot air drying and automatic door opening functions, so I chose it! There are many models that are 100,000 to 200,000 won cheaper, but they don't have hot air drying functions. Installation cost of the dishwasher. This dishwasher seems to fit a 12(?), 10(?)cm mop holder. Since my mop holder is 15cm, I cut a little bit of the mop holder and installed it when I was cutting the dishwasher! I paid 90,000 won for the dishwasher separately. Installation period after purchase. It's so fast. I thought it would be good if they installed it within a month. I completed the payment during the strong sale period on February 13th. On the 18th, the installer came and installed it for about an hour! The next day! On the 19th, the installer came and installed it for an hour! It took less than a week from payment to installation. The advantages I felt after using it. I was reluctant to put oily things in because I thought it was a new product. My husband doesn't have that kind of problem. I just took the frying pan and the gas range, as you can see in the picture, apart and just threw it away. What should I do with this oil? I washed it well without oil! The best! The color. My house is all wood-toned, so I thought white wouldn't go well, so I bought white thinking, 'I'll have to do the seat work,' but when I actually installed it, I thought, 'It goes better than I thought.' I put the seat work on hold for now~ (It's annoying.) Lastly. I've been thinking about buying a dishwasher for over a year. Do I really need a dishwasher when we live together? I don't even cook at home, so I don't need it! But when I brought in the dishwasher aunt, things changed. It is absolutely essential. I bought a dishwasher because I have a baby coming soon. I just regret the time I spent worrying about it. Newlyweds, don't worry and buy it.

I don't know what designer picked a red light to shine when the machine is operating as it should, but at least it is an indication. Sentence (English): I would have given this dishwasher a good rating within a few months of buying it.
Comments (English): [ WARNING - DO NOT BUY! ] || ---------------- || I would have given this dishwasher a good rating within a few months of buying it. However, within the warranty period, we noticed that water was leaking from the unit. The repairman fixed the leak by replacing the faulty float switch and commented that where the heating element attaches to the tub would corrode (known problem) but he couldn't replace it then because ours appeared to be intact at the time. Fast forward a year later, water was leaking again and we found out that the posts that secure the heating element to the tub had corroded and parts of those corroded pieces fell off and were lodged into the pump's impeller, shredded the screen, and seized up the motor so now we have to replace the heating element and the circulation pump assembly. Of course, this is no longer within the warranty period. To say that we are frustrated is an understatement. We now have a damaged floor as a result of the leaks as well as paying for new parts. I have read on posts that people have had thousands of dollars of damage due to this dishwasher. I will never buy a Kitchenaid again. Why can't companies build appliances with parts that are built to last?
