Sentence (English): Negative stars if I could.
Comments (English): [ Run From This Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Negative stars if I could. Bought this because I was raised in Louisville with GE Appliance Park families. Never again. These are the dishwasher's key problems after 3 hours of installation time:1. The traditional twin steel tabs that attach the dishwasher to the underside of the counter top have been "optimized" by a GE engineer who obviously never installed a dishwasher. These tabs need to be firmly attached to the dishwasher's frame/tub assembly because they provide lateral alignment of the unit and keep the dishwasher's door from scraping adjacent cabinets. The "optimized" brackets rattle loose in their mounts and have zero ability to align the dishwasher.This design flaw alone is enough to make any potential buyer run. I went back to store to inquire if there is a fascia kit that frames the dishwasher in its cabinet opening. My hope was that this frame kit would provide the alignment the new mounting-to-counter tabs don't. The Home Depot lady said such framing kits are no longer available.2. GE dishwashers no longer have a stamped steel frame but a thin hollow bent tube surrounding the tub. This bent tube has so little steel in it that the qty=4 feet on the dishwasher strip out of their mounting holes. Someone at GE thought these adjustable feet could reliably serve as thread forming screws. Nope.3. There is zero sound-reduction padding on this dishwasher. I had to strip the padding off the old dishwasher and tape it to GE's tub.

Sentence (English): Bought this dishwasher for the noise level rating.
Comments (English): [ Never again GE, replacing after 2 years. ] || ---------------- || Bought this dishwasher for the noise level rating. It is a very quiet machine. It has many problems. We have had machine 2 years and are now going to replace it. During the 1st year we notice large pieces of black plastic (the size of your hand) on the floor in front of it after we ran it. We couldn't figure out what it what or where is came from. Finally after many internet searches we found out it was material in the door for sound reduction. A few months after the trim on top of the control panel would pop off at the corners. And wouldn't pop back stay in and if you passed to close would catch on your clothes.Now this week the cabinet on the left side buckled and has severe water damage. We pulled it out the dishwasher and ran it so we could see if it was a hose , drum and where the leak was. There is a steady drip on the side of the dishwasher from box in the picture. Not from either of the hoses showing, the box itself. We have no idea how long it's been leaking because the water ran back towards the wall. So we also have damage back there to fix. We think it has been leaking for quite a while since it is a slow steady drip when running and the feet on the left side of the dish washer are already rusted. The damage from this leak is heartbreaking as the cabinet and sheetrock will need to be replaced. This is my second GE appliance, the other is the profile Refridgerater and both have been disappointing.

Comments (English): [ Not as expected and not worth the price tag ] || ---------------- || We've had a builder grade Frigidaire dishwasher that was 13 years old. Truthfully nothing wrong other than we wanted to upgrade. We did a lot of research and kept coming back to Bosch 500 as it appeared to be recommended and highly rated product. I like the drop down baskets, but not much more. It's actually not as quiet as you would expect, which is not a huge deal breaker for me. The biggest issue is the dish cycles are typically 2-3 hours and after trying all of the dry cycles (sanitize and auto air) along with the intensive dry setting and allowing the door to open upon completion of the cycle, our dishes are still soaking wet. You can't return to Lowe's after 48 hours if it's been used. As a person who really digs into details before making big purchases, I would caution those who are considering this product to look else where for the price.

UV살균모드랑 문열림기능도 on/off가능하고 어르신들도 편하게 쓸 것 같아 진지하게 엄마집도 사드리고싶습니다. 하지만 3인이상 가구면 6인 사이즈 자체가 작아서 12-14인용 추천드려요.  1-2인+ 아기있는 가정, 빌트인 안되는 집, 타공원하지 않는 집에 추천드립니다.  고열건조? 건조기능이 따로 없어서 처음에는 당황스럽습니다.  한번만 물로 애벌해서 넣으면 기름때까지 싸악 안쪽과 바깥 모두 뽀득뽀득 잘 닦이는데 밥그릇 뒷면 엎어진 오목한 부분 등에 물이 고여있긴합니다. 하지만 자동으로 문이 열림기능이 있고 저녁먹고 돌리고 다음날 아침에 보면 거의 한두방울 물기정도만 뒷면 오목한 부분에 남아있는 정도이고, 저희는 그냥 그마저도 싫어서 다되면 싱크대에 빼두어서 바짝 말리기는 하는데 전혀 불편하지 않고 오히려 뽀득뽀득 씻긴 그릇에 기분이 좋습니다!  참고로 저희집은 L자형의 장점을 다 살리지 못하고 수전부분에 걸려서 45도정도밖에 열리지 않음에도 만족하고 사용중입니다. 1층먼저 쌓아 넣고 2층 조립해서 채우면 됩니당. 남들이 보기엔 불편할 수 있지만 그만큼 세정력이나 편리함 등이 만족스럽기에 저희처럼 특수한 구조에서도 필요하신 분 있다면 구입에 참조하시면 좋겠고 더 넓은 주방이라면 L자 일자로 다 펴지고 훨씬 수월하게 이용할 수 있을 것 같아 추천드립니다.  참고로 저희는 싱크대 바로옆이라 따로 타공하지않고 배수관 연결 바로 싱크대로 빼고 물끌어오는 부분은 옆 벽면을 타도록 설치해서 외관상으로도 만족스럽습니다.  AS도 쿠팡에서 해준다니 편하게 사용하려고요. 무엇보다 일단 가격도 타브랜드의 1/2값이라 가격대비 매우 만족입니다!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. (There is a hole drilled, but it cannot be installed in a location where the drain line passes through the induction, it cannot be installed within 30 cm of the induction (fireplace), and the size is not suitable for placing it right next to the sink, etc.) I bought the product because it was said that it can be installed without drilling and can be installed next to the induction or fireplace. The technician contacted me the next day to coordinate the installation time, and it was installed the day after I purchased it. The technician also had a difficult reaction at first because of our narrow and unique kitchen structure, but he kindly thought about it with me, and this is also one of the parts that I am satisfied with. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. However, the door opens automatically, and when you turn it on after dinner and look at it the next morning, there are only a few drops of water left in the concave part on the back, and we don't even like that, so we put it in the sink and dry it completely, but it is not inconvenient at all, and it feels good to see the dishes that have been washed cleanly! For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. (There is a hole drilled, but it cannot be installed in a location where the drain line passes through the induction, it cannot be installed within 30 cm of the induction (fireplace), and the size is not suitable for placing it right next to the sink, etc.) I bought the product because it was said that it can be installed without drilling and can be installed next to the induction or fireplace. The technician contacted me the next day to coordinate the installation time, and it was installed the day after I purchased it. The technician also had a difficult reaction at first because of our narrow and unique kitchen structure, but he kindly thought about it with me, and this is also one of the parts that I am satisfied with. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. However, the door opens automatically, and when you turn it on after dinner and look at it the next morning, there are only a few drops of water left in the concave part on the back, and we don't even like that, so we put it in the sink and dry it completely, but it is not inconvenient at all, and it feels good to see the dishes that have been washed cleanly! For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. (There is a hole drilled, but it cannot be installed in a location where the drain line passes through the induction, it cannot be installed within 30 cm of the induction (fireplace), and the size is not suitable for placing it right next to the sink, etc.) I bought the product because it was said that it can be installed without drilling and can be installed next to the induction or fireplace. The technician contacted me the next day to coordinate the installation time, and it was installed the day after I purchased it. The technician also had a difficult reaction at first because of our narrow and unique kitchen structure, but he kindly thought about it with me, and this is also one of the parts that I am satisfied with. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. However, the door opens automatically, and when you turn it on after dinner and look at it the next morning, there are only a few drops of water left in the concave part on the back, and we don't even like that, so we put it in the sink and dry it completely, but it is not inconvenient at all, and it feels good to see the dishes that have been washed cleanly! For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Sentence (English): I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought.
Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. (There is a hole drilled, but it cannot be installed in a location where the drain line passes through the induction, it cannot be installed within 30 cm of the induction (fireplace), and the size is not suitable for placing it right next to the sink, etc.) I bought the product because it was said that it can be installed without drilling and can be installed next to the induction or fireplace. The technician contacted me the next day to coordinate the installation time, and it was installed the day after I purchased it. The technician also had a difficult reaction at first because of our narrow and unique kitchen structure, but he kindly thought about it with me, and this is also one of the parts that I am satisfied with. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. However, the door opens automatically, and when you turn it on after dinner and look at it the next morning, there are only a few drops of water left in the concave part on the back, and we don't even like that, so we put it in the sink and dry it completely, but it is not inconvenient at all, and it feels good to see the dishes that have been washed cleanly! For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. The technician also had a difficult reaction at first because of our narrow and unique kitchen structure, but he kindly thought about it with me, and this is also one of the parts that I am satisfied with. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. However, the door opens automatically, and when you turn it on after dinner and look at it the next morning, there are only a few drops of water left in the concave part on the back, and we don't even like that, so we put it in the sink and dry it completely, but it is not inconvenient at all, and it feels good to see the dishes that have been washed cleanly! For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. The technician contacted me the next day to coordinate the installation time, and it was installed the day after I purchased it. The technician also had a difficult reaction at first because of our narrow and unique kitchen structure, but he kindly thought about it with me, and this is also one of the parts that I am satisfied with. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. First, the situation of my house. - 25 pyeong lease, difficulty in built-in. - Samsung, LG 6-person installation is not suitable due to the unique structure of the kitchen. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Comments (English): [ This is a review of a product I bought with my own money. ] || ---------------- || I hesitated because there were no reviews of my own products, but I wanted to use it, but there was a limit, so I tried it and I was very satisfied, so I am leaving a review. I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

I reluctantly decided to buy a 6-person product because I was worried about washing dishes before giving birth, but I am more satisfied than I thought. It's so easy to set up and it's perfect for two people to turn over breakfast and dinner. It may be because I'm not good at stacking, but after using it for about 3 weeks, I use a frying pan for every meal, such as meat or fries, and I often use a pot, so I think I can only turn over one meal if I put in a frying pan and a pot. When I turn it over once a day, I turn it over except for wooden utensils, frying pans, and pots, and when I put in a pot and frying pan, I turn over one meal. The button operation is also very simple. Just turn it on (there's a mode that's set as default) and press play. The default setting is 65 minutes, and it cleans everything very well. The frying pan where I grilled LA ribs and the plate where I made red oil left over from eating spicy braised chicken are all gone. You can also rinse and wash it, but I haven't used it yet. The UV sterilization mode and door opening function can be turned on/off, and I think the elderly will find it convenient to use, so I seriously want to buy one for my mom's house. However, if there are more than 3 people, the 6-person size itself is small, so I recommend the 12-14-person size. I recommend it for 1-2 people + a baby, a house without a built-in, or a house without a trolley. High-heat drying? It is confusing at first because there is no separate drying function. If you put it in water once, it will clean the inside and outside of the oil stains well, but there is water in the concave part on the back of the rice bowl. For reference, my house cannot fully utilize the advantages of the L-shape, and it is only open about 45 degrees because it gets caught in the faucet, but I am satisfied and using it. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Since Coupang also provides after-sales service, we plan to use it conveniently. Above all, the price is half the price of other brands, so we are very satisfied with the price-to-performance ratio!

If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. Stack the first floor first, and then assemble the second floor to fill it. It may look inconvenient to others, but the cleaning power and convenience are satisfactory, so if there is anyone who needs it in a special structure like ours, I recommend it for your purchase. If you have a larger kitchen, I recommend it because it can be opened out in an L shape and used much more conveniently. For reference, ours is right next to the sink, so we didn't drill a separate hole, but connected the drain pipe directly to the sink, and installed the part where the water is drawn along the side wall, so we are satisfied with the appearance. Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher with good space utilization ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Dishwashers have become an essential home appliance. However, my family has always insisted on hand washing. After using a dishwasher for the first time, I realized that dishwashers are a whole new world! Although it is for 6 people, I was skeptical about whether it would fit a family of 4 because it seems to be compact, but it is very space-efficient. I think people with small households will be even more satisfied with it. [Size] There are many households that have difficulty installing a dishwasher. This dishwasher is a reasonable size, but it can hold more dishes than you think, so you can use it without difficulty. It seems to be space-efficient. I think you can install it without difficulty even if your kitchen is small. [Design] It is a very pretty ivory color. Rather than a plain dishwasher, this pretty dishwasher makes the kitchen look fresher and looks good in terms of interior design. Is this really a dishwasher? It is so pretty in person. The LED lights come on softly, so I am even more satisfied. Also, it is said that it can be installed even in a narrow sink because there is about 15cm of space when the door is opened. [Function] The performance is really good! The dishwashing system with 3 washing wings makes the dishes shine and clean very well. The wings rotate on the ceiling, walls, and floor and spray the washing water, so it washes the dishes very well. I used to blindly believe in hand washing, but it washes the dishes more thoroughly and cleanly than hand washing. It's a new world. And, there are 4 washing courses, so you can use them according to your purpose. When washing dishes with old food stuck to them, use the strong mode. For dishes that are likely to deform at high temperatures, use the low temperature course. It's good that you can select the washing course according to your desired mode. The automatic door opening function is a must-have. When washing is complete, the door automatically opens to remove moisture, so there is no problem even if you do something else without realizing that the washing mode is over. It automatically ventilates. Above all, the UV lamp function removes any remaining bacteria, so you can wash and use the dishes with even more confidence. This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!
Comments (Original): [ 공간활용도가 좋은 가성비 좋은 식기세척기 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  이제는 식기세척기가 가정에서의 필수 전자제품이 되었죠. 그렇지만 저희 가족은 손 설거지를 고수해왔는데요.. 식기세척기를 처음 사용해보니 역시 식세기는 신세계가 맞네요! 6인용이긴 하지만 컴펙트인 크기일 것 같아서 4인 가족에게도 맞을까 의구심이 들었는데 공간 활용도가 좋아서 매우 충분해요. 소형 가구분들은 더더욱 만족하면서 쓰실 것 같아요~  [크기] 식기세척기를 설치할 공간이 난감한 가정이 많잖아요~ 이 식세기는 적당한 크기에 생각보다 많은 그릇이 들어가서 무리없이 사용하실 수 있고요. 공간 활용도가 좋은 것 같아요. 부엌이 좁으시더라도 무리없이 설치하실 수 있을 것 같아요.  [디자인] 엄청 예쁜 아이보리색인데요~ 투박한 식세기보다 이렇게 예쁜 식세기가 부엌의 분위기도 좀 더 산뜻하게 해주고 인테리어면에서도 좋은 것 같아요. 식세기 맞아? 할 정도로 실물이 예뻐요. LED도 은은하게 들어와서 더욱 더 만족스러워요. 또, 문을 열 때 15cm정도의 여유 공간이 있어서 좁은 싱크대에도 설치가 가능하다고 해요.  [기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

[기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

Sentence (English): After using a dishwasher for the first time, I realized that dishwashers are a whole new world!
Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher with good space utilization ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Dishwashers have become an essential home appliance. However, my family has always insisted on hand washing. After using a dishwasher for the first time, I realized that dishwashers are a whole new world! Although it is for 6 people, I was skeptical about whether it would fit a family of 4 because it seems to be compact, but it is very space-efficient. I think people with small households will be even more satisfied with it. [Size] There are many households that have difficulty installing a dishwasher. This dishwasher is a reasonable size, but it can hold more dishes than you think, so you can use it without difficulty. It seems to be space-efficient. I think you can install it without difficulty even if your kitchen is small. [Design] It is a very pretty ivory color. Rather than a plain dishwasher, this pretty dishwasher makes the kitchen look fresher and looks good in terms of interior design. Is this really a dishwasher? It is so pretty in person. The LED lights come on softly, so I am even more satisfied. Also, it is said that it can be installed even in a narrow sink because there is about 15cm of space when the door is opened. [Function] The performance is really good! The dishwashing system with 3 washing wings makes the dishes shine and clean very well. The wings rotate on the ceiling, walls, and floor and spray the washing water, so it washes the dishes very well. I used to blindly believe in hand washing, but it washes the dishes more thoroughly and cleanly than hand washing. It's a new world. And, there are 4 washing courses, so you can use them according to your purpose. When washing dishes with old food stuck to them, use the strong mode. For dishes that are likely to deform at high temperatures, use the low temperature course. It's good that you can select the washing course according to your desired mode. The automatic door opening function is a must-have. When washing is complete, the door automatically opens to remove moisture, so there is no problem even if you do something else without realizing that the washing mode is over. It automatically ventilates. Above all, the UV lamp function removes any remaining bacteria, so you can wash and use the dishes with even more confidence. This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!

[기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!

[기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

[기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

The LED lights come on softly, so I am even more satisfied. Also, it is said that it can be installed even in a narrow sink because there is about 15cm of space when the door is opened. The automatic door opening function is a must-have. When washing is complete, the door automatically opens to remove moisture, so there is no problem even if you do something else without realizing that the washing mode is over. It automatically ventilates. Above all, the UV lamp function removes any remaining bacteria, so you can wash and use the dishes with even more confidence. This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!

[기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

Dishwashers have become an essential home appliance. However, my family has always insisted on hand washing. After using a dishwasher for the first time, I realized that dishwashers are a whole new world! Although it is for 6 people, I was skeptical about whether it would fit a family of 4 because it seems to be compact, but it is very space-efficient. I think people with small households will be even more satisfied with it. [Size] There are many households that have difficulty installing a dishwasher. This dishwasher is a reasonable size, but it can hold more dishes than you think, so you can use it without difficulty. It seems to be space-efficient. I think you can install it without difficulty even if your kitchen is small. [Design] It is a very pretty ivory color. Rather than a plain dishwasher, this pretty dishwasher makes the kitchen look fresher and looks good in terms of interior design. Is this really a dishwasher? It is so pretty in person. The LED lights come on softly, so I am even more satisfied. Also, it is said that it can be installed even in a narrow sink because there is about 15cm of space when the door is opened. [Function] The performance is really good! The dishwashing system with 3 washing wings makes the dishes shine and clean very well. The wings rotate on the ceiling, walls, and floor and spray the washing water, so it washes the dishes very well. I used to blindly believe in hand washing, but it washes the dishes more thoroughly and cleanly than hand washing. It's a new world. And, there are 4 washing courses, so you can use them according to your purpose. When washing dishes with old food stuck to them, use the strong mode. For dishes that are likely to deform at high temperatures, use the low temperature course. It's good that you can select the washing course according to your desired mode. The automatic door opening function is a must-have. When washing is complete, the door automatically opens to remove moisture, so there is no problem even if you do something else without realizing that the washing mode is over. It automatically ventilates. Above all, the UV lamp function removes any remaining bacteria, so you can wash and use the dishes with even more confidence. This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!

[기능] 성능이 정말 좋네요! 3개의 세척 날개로 이루어진 세척 시스템 덕분에 그릇이 반질반질 아주 말끔하게 닦여요. 천장, 벽, 바닥에서 날개가 회전하며 세척수가 분사돼서 그릇의 이곳 저곳 아주 잘 닦여요. 손 설거지를 맹신해왔는데 오히려 손 설거지보다 꼼꼼하고 깨끗하게 닦아주네요.. 신세계에요. 그리고, 4가지 세척코스가 있어서 목적에 맞게 사용하실 수 있어요. 오래된 음식물이 붙은 식기를 세척할 땐 강력 모드로~ 고온에서 변형이 될 것 같은 식기는 저온코스로~ 원하시는 모드에 따라 세척 코스를 선택할 수 있다는게 좋아요.  자동 문열림 기능은 말모고요. 세척이 완료되면 자동으로 문이 열려서 습기를 제거해주기 때문에 세척 모드가 끝났다는 것을 인지하지 못하고 다른 일을 할지라도 문제가 없어요. 알아서 환기시켜주니깐요. 무엇보다 UV램프 기능이 들어가서 잔여 세균도 제거해주기 때문에 더욱 믿고 식기를 세척해서 사용할 수 있어요. 소음도 크지 않고 여러모로 만족스러운 식기세척기입니다!

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher with good space utilization ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Dishwashers have become an essential home appliance. However, my family has always insisted on hand washing. After using a dishwasher for the first time, I realized that dishwashers are a whole new world! Although it is for 6 people, I was skeptical about whether it would fit a family of 4 because it seems to be compact, but it is very space-efficient. I think people with small households will be even more satisfied with it. [Size] There are many households that have difficulty installing a dishwasher. This dishwasher is a reasonable size, but it can hold more dishes than you think, so you can use it without difficulty. It seems to be space-efficient. I think you can install it without difficulty even if your kitchen is small. [Design] It is a very pretty ivory color. Rather than a plain dishwasher, this pretty dishwasher makes the kitchen look fresher and looks good in terms of interior design. Is this really a dishwasher? It is so pretty in person. The LED lights come on softly, so I am even more satisfied. Also, it is said that it can be installed even in a narrow sink because there is about 15cm of space when the door is opened. [Function] The performance is really good! The dishwashing system with 3 washing wings makes the dishes shine and clean very well. The wings rotate on the ceiling, walls, and floor and spray the washing water, so it washes the dishes very well. I used to blindly believe in hand washing, but it washes the dishes more thoroughly and cleanly than hand washing. It's a new world. And, there are 4 washing courses, so you can use them according to your purpose. When washing dishes with old food stuck to them, use the strong mode. For dishes that are likely to deform at high temperatures, use the low temperature course. It's good that you can select the washing course according to your desired mode. The automatic door opening function is a must-have. When washing is complete, the door automatically opens to remove moisture, so there is no problem even if you do something else without realizing that the washing mode is over. It automatically ventilates. Above all, the UV lamp function removes any remaining bacteria, so you can wash and use the dishes with even more confidence. This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!

Comments (English): [ A cost-effective dishwasher with good space utilization ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. Dishwashers have become an essential home appliance. However, my family has always insisted on hand washing. I think people with small households will be even more satisfied with it. [Size] There are many households that have difficulty installing a dishwasher. The automatic door opening function is a must-have. When washing is complete, the door automatically opens to remove moisture, so there is no problem even if you do something else without realizing that the washing mode is over. It automatically ventilates. Above all, the UV lamp function removes any remaining bacteria, so you can wash and use the dishes with even more confidence. This dishwasher is not too noisy and is satisfactory in many ways!

Sentence (English): I've heard a lot about the dishwasher aunt lately.
Comments (English): [ It's a new world ] || ---------------- || I've heard a lot about the dishwasher aunt lately. I'm a family of four and we don't eat much at home, so I didn't think I'd need a dishwasher, but it's a whole new world after using it. I simply removed the food and put it away, and I was done without worrying about it and did other things. I was impressed by the kindness of the installer, and I was worried that the holes would be too big, but they were less than 1cm and didn't look bad, so I'm even more satisfied. It takes longer than washing dishes by hand, but I can do other things during that time, and it's also cleanly sterilized, so it's cleaner than when I do it by hand. It's not too big, so I don't feel uncomfortable even though it's not built-in. I also like that the automatic door opens after washing to let the moisture out. It's compact, but it has two baskets and a separate cutlery holder, so it seems like a family of four can use it very comfortably. Since it is a window-type door, you can see it rotating and it is easy to use, so I am very satisfied with it so far. It is a great value for money dishwasher. I recommend it to those who are having trouble deciding on a dishwasher. ^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (Original): [ 신세계에요 ] || ---------------- || 요즘  식세기 이모님 좋다는 소문을 많이 들었어요. 전 4인가족에 집에서 밥도 많이 안 먹으니 설겆이 거리도 적고 해서 식세기까지 필요할까했는데  사용해보니 완전 신세계네요. 음식물만 간단히 제거해서 돌려봤는데 신경쓸꺼없이 두고 다른 일하다보니 끝났네요.  설치 기사님 너무 친절하셔서 감동했고 타공 구멍 클까봐 걱정했는데 1센티도 안되게 구멍뚫어서 보기에도 나쁘지 않아서 더 만족.  손으로 설겆이하는것 보다는 시간이 소요되지만 그 시간에 다른일 할수있고 또 깨끗히 살균까지되니 내가 손으로하는것보다 더 깨끗.  크기도 많이 안커서 빌트인 아니라도 거부감이 적다는.  세척후 자동도어 오픈되어 습기가 빠지는것도 좋아요  콤팩트한 사이즈지만 바스켓이 2단이고 수저통도 따로있어서 4인가족은 아주 넉넉히 사용가능할듯.  창문형 도어라서 돌아가는것도 볼수있고 사용법도 간단해서 지금까지는 대만족 가성비 너무좋은 식세기 이모님 고민하시는분들께 추천해요^^ 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Made in Korea (식세기 중 유일)  추가 설치 해도 되고 안 해도 되는: 콘센트가 멀어서 고민하다 싱크대 아래 콘센트에 연결하기로 결정 후 추가금 38,000 결제함(심미적인 부분에 투자하느냐만 선택하면 됨) 멀티탭으로 연결하거나 콘센트가 가까우면 추가 필요 없음. 싱크대 턱에 이미 타공 돼 있어서 배수호스 깔끔하게 연결함 단점: 아직은 없...  설치비는 무료!  카드할인 행사해서 좋은 가격으로 샀구요. 쿠팡은 매일 가격변동이 있고 그때그때 카드할인이나 와우할인 혜택이 생기니 지켜보시다가 가격 좋은 날 구매하시면 돼요. 저는 일요일 밤에 샀는데 월요일에 가격 오르다가 주말 쯤 다시 내리더라고요. 며칠 사이 이벤트가 달라지지만 가격차이가 그리 크진 않았고 하루라도 빨리 설치해서 노동에서 벗어나는 게 돈 버는 길인 듯 해요. 기사님도 친절하셨고 작업은 마무리 사인까지 한 시간 정도 걸렸어요.  6인용 살까말까 고민 중이시면 국낸 생산인 엘지 추천드려요. 저는 12인용보다 훨씬 실용적인 거 같아요. 설거지 스트레스 날려보아요~~~:)

Sentence (English): I couldn't install a 12-person model, so I decided on a countertop 6-person model.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Life 25 Years Recommended Items (This is a review of a product I bought with my own money) ] || ---------------- || I started with the LG 6-person dishwasher, then the LG 12-person No. 1, and the Samsung 12-person No. 2. LG was very satisfactory, but I was dissatisfied with the Samsung in terms of cleaning power and durability. So when I moved, I thought I had to go with LG. I couldn't install a 12-person model, so I decided on a countertop 6-person model. I was worried that it would be too small for a family of 3, but it's actually more comfortable, so I highly recommend it :) Advantages 1. Intuitive door opening button. Most models open by bending your wrist, but it's easier on your wrist and more comfortable to open up and down by lightly pressing the button with your finger. 2. Efficient in narrow spaces and not small in any way. It doesn't take up as much space as you'd think, and it has a two-tier tray, so you can put things on top, and you can put tall pots, etc. without removing the upper tray. 3. Stainless steel dish rack. The inner dish rack is made of stainless steel, not plastic silicone coating, so it's luxurious and safe (I liked it the most because the coating sometimes peeled off and rusted). 4. Dual cleaning wings. Two cleaning wings underneath clean evenly. 5. High-temperature water washing, hot air drying, UV sterilization function. It dries in hot air at 80 degrees Celsius, and additionally It also has a sterilizing function, so it's good until it's hot and crispy. It's easy to sterilize and disinfect cutting boards and knives. 6. It's perfect for those who are lazy because you can just drop a spoonful into the concave part of the detergent compartment door. (When using the ** frog, it was cumbersome to cut and the unique smell was hard for a dog person like me, so I settled on the unscented Nelly (powder type), but I recommend Nelly because it leaves almost no stains and has good ingredients. You only need to use a small amount.) 7. After drying the CD with hot air, the CD (Cool Dry) internal ventilation operates. You can stop it with the stop button in the middle and open the door to dry naturally. There is no automatic door opening function, but it seems that there is no problem with the internal drying because of this function. 8. It saves movement, and you can organize dishes right away by opening the sink storage cabinet. 9. It protects your back because you don't have to bend over^^ 10. Made in Korea (the only dishwasher) Additional installation is possible or not: I was worried because the outlet was far away, so I decided to connect it to the outlet under the sink and paid an additional fee of 38,000 (you just have to choose whether to invest in the aesthetic part). If you connect it to a multi-tap or the outlet is close, you don't need to add anything. The sink ledge is already perforated, so you can connect the drain hose neatly. Disadvantages: None yet. Installation fee is free! I bought it at a good price because there was a card discount event. Coupang's prices change every day, and there are card discounts or Wow discount benefits at that time, so you can watch and buy it on a good day. I bought it on Sunday night, and the price went up on Monday and then went down again around the weekend. The event changes in a few days, but the price difference is not that big, and it seems that the way to make money is to install it as soon as possible and get rid of labor. The technician was kind and the work took about an hour to complete. If you are thinking about buying a 6-person one, I recommend LG, which is a domestically produced product. I think it is much more practical than a 12-person one. Let's blow away the stress of washing dishes~~~:)

Made in Korea (식세기 중 유일)  추가 설치 해도 되고 안 해도 되는: 콘센트가 멀어서 고민하다 싱크대 아래 콘센트에 연결하기로 결정 후 추가금 38,000 결제함(심미적인 부분에 투자하느냐만 선택하면 됨) 멀티탭으로 연결하거나 콘센트가 가까우면 추가 필요 없음. 싱크대 턱에 이미 타공 돼 있어서 배수호스 깔끔하게 연결함 단점: 아직은 없...  설치비는 무료!  카드할인 행사해서 좋은 가격으로 샀구요. 쿠팡은 매일 가격변동이 있고 그때그때 카드할인이나 와우할인 혜택이 생기니 지켜보시다가 가격 좋은 날 구매하시면 돼요. 저는 일요일 밤에 샀는데 월요일에 가격 오르다가 주말 쯤 다시 내리더라고요. 며칠 사이 이벤트가 달라지지만 가격차이가 그리 크진 않았고 하루라도 빨리 설치해서 노동에서 벗어나는 게 돈 버는 길인 듯 해요. 기사님도 친절하셨고 작업은 마무리 사인까지 한 시간 정도 걸렸어요.  6인용 살까말까 고민 중이시면 국낸 생산인 엘지 추천드려요. 저는 12인용보다 훨씬 실용적인 거 같아요. 설거지 스트레스 날려보아요~~~:)

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Life 25 Years Recommended Items (This is a review of a product I bought with my own money) ] || ---------------- || I started with the LG 6-person dishwasher, then the LG 12-person No. 1, and the Samsung 12-person No. 2. LG was very satisfactory, but I was dissatisfied with the Samsung in terms of cleaning power and durability. So when I moved, I thought I had to go with LG. I couldn't install a 12-person model, so I decided on a countertop 6-person model. I was worried that it would be too small for a family of 3, but it's actually more comfortable, so I highly recommend it :) Advantages 1. Intuitive door opening button. Most models open by bending your wrist, but it's easier on your wrist and more comfortable to open up and down by lightly pressing the button with your finger. 2. Efficient in narrow spaces and not small in any way. It doesn't take up as much space as you'd think, and it has a two-tier tray, so you can put things on top, and you can put tall pots, etc. without removing the upper tray. 3. Stainless steel dish rack. The inner dish rack is made of stainless steel, not plastic silicone coating, so it's luxurious and safe (I liked it the most because the coating sometimes peeled off and rusted). 4. Dual cleaning wings. Two cleaning wings underneath clean evenly. 5. High-temperature water washing, hot air drying, UV sterilization function. It dries in hot air at 80 degrees Celsius, and additionally It also has a sterilizing function, so it's good until it's hot and crispy. It's easy to sterilize and disinfect cutting boards and knives. 6. It's perfect for those who are lazy because you can just drop a spoonful into the concave part of the detergent compartment door. (When using the ** frog, it was cumbersome to cut and the unique smell was hard for a dog person like me, so I settled on the unscented Nelly (powder type), but I recommend Nelly because it leaves almost no stains and has good ingredients. You only need to use a small amount.) 7. After drying the CD with hot air, the CD (Cool Dry) internal ventilation operates. You can stop it with the stop button in the middle and open the door to dry naturally. There is no automatic door opening function, but it seems that there is no problem with the internal drying because of this function. 8. It saves movement, and you can organize dishes right away by opening the sink storage cabinet. 9. It protects your back because you don't have to bend over^^ 10. Made in Korea (the only dishwasher) Additional installation is possible or not: I was worried because the outlet was far away, so I decided to connect it to the outlet under the sink and paid an additional fee of 38,000 (you just have to choose whether to invest in the aesthetic part). If you connect it to a multi-tap or the outlet is close, you don't need to add anything. The sink ledge is already perforated, so you can connect the drain hose neatly. Disadvantages: None yet. Installation fee is free! I bought it at a good price because there was a card discount event. Coupang's prices change every day, and there are card discounts or Wow discount benefits at that time, so you can watch and buy it on a good day. I bought it on Sunday night, and the price went up on Monday and then went down again around the weekend. The event changes in a few days, but the price difference is not that big, and it seems that the way to make money is to install it as soon as possible and get rid of labor. The technician was kind and the work took about an hour to complete. If you are thinking about buying a 6-person one, I recommend LG, which is a domestically produced product. I think it is much more practical than a 12-person one. Let's blow away the stress of washing dishes~~~:)

Made in Korea (식세기 중 유일)  추가 설치 해도 되고 안 해도 되는: 콘센트가 멀어서 고민하다 싱크대 아래 콘센트에 연결하기로 결정 후 추가금 38,000 결제함(심미적인 부분에 투자하느냐만 선택하면 됨) 멀티탭으로 연결하거나 콘센트가 가까우면 추가 필요 없음. 싱크대 턱에 이미 타공 돼 있어서 배수호스 깔끔하게 연결함 단점: 아직은 없...  설치비는 무료!  카드할인 행사해서 좋은 가격으로 샀구요. 쿠팡은 매일 가격변동이 있고 그때그때 카드할인이나 와우할인 혜택이 생기니 지켜보시다가 가격 좋은 날 구매하시면 돼요. 저는 일요일 밤에 샀는데 월요일에 가격 오르다가 주말 쯤 다시 내리더라고요. 며칠 사이 이벤트가 달라지지만 가격차이가 그리 크진 않았고 하루라도 빨리 설치해서 노동에서 벗어나는 게 돈 버는 길인 듯 해요. 기사님도 친절하셨고 작업은 마무리 사인까지 한 시간 정도 걸렸어요.  6인용 살까말까 고민 중이시면 국낸 생산인 엘지 추천드려요. 저는 12인용보다 훨씬 실용적인 거 같아요. 설거지 스트레스 날려보아요~~~:)

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Life 25 Years Recommended Items (This is a review of a product I bought with my own money) ] || ---------------- || I started with the LG 6-person dishwasher, then the LG 12-person No. 1, and the Samsung 12-person No. 2. LG was very satisfactory, but I was dissatisfied with the Samsung in terms of cleaning power and durability. So when I moved, I thought I had to go with LG. I couldn't install a 12-person model, so I decided on a countertop 6-person model. I was worried that it would be too small for a family of 3, but it's actually more comfortable, so I highly recommend it :) Advantages 1. Intuitive door opening button. Most models open by bending your wrist, but it's easier on your wrist and more comfortable to open up and down by lightly pressing the button with your finger. 2. Efficient in narrow spaces and not small in any way. It doesn't take up as much space as you'd think, and it has a two-tier tray, so you can put things on top, and you can put tall pots, etc. without removing the upper tray. 3. Stainless steel dish rack. The inner dish rack is made of stainless steel, not plastic silicone coating, so it's luxurious and safe (I liked it the most because the coating sometimes peeled off and rusted). 4. Dual cleaning wings. Two cleaning wings underneath clean evenly. 5. High-temperature water washing, hot air drying, UV sterilization function. It dries in hot air at 80 degrees Celsius, and additionally It also has a sterilizing function, so it's good until it's hot and crispy. It's easy to sterilize and disinfect cutting boards and knives. 6. It's perfect for those who are lazy because you can just drop a spoonful into the concave part of the detergent compartment door. (When using the ** frog, it was cumbersome to cut and the unique smell was hard for a dog person like me, so I settled on the unscented Nelly (powder type), but I recommend Nelly because it leaves almost no stains and has good ingredients. You only need to use a small amount.) 7. After drying the CD with hot air, the CD (Cool Dry) internal ventilation operates. You can stop it with the stop button in the middle and open the door to dry naturally. There is no automatic door opening function, but it seems that there is no problem with the internal drying because of this function. 8. It saves movement, and you can organize dishes right away by opening the sink storage cabinet. 9. It protects your back because you don't have to bend over^^ 10. Made in Korea (the only dishwasher) Additional installation is possible or not: I was worried because the outlet was far away, so I decided to connect it to the outlet under the sink and paid an additional fee of 38,000 (you just have to choose whether to invest in the aesthetic part). If you connect it to a multi-tap or the outlet is close, you don't need to add anything. The sink ledge is already perforated, so you can connect the drain hose neatly. Disadvantages: None yet. Installation fee is free! I bought it at a good price because there was a card discount event. Coupang's prices change every day, and there are card discounts or Wow discount benefits at that time, so you can watch and buy it on a good day. I bought it on Sunday night, and the price went up on Monday and then went down again around the weekend. The event changes in a few days, but the price difference is not that big, and it seems that the way to make money is to install it as soon as possible and get rid of labor. The technician was kind and the work took about an hour to complete. If you are thinking about buying a 6-person one, I recommend LG, which is a domestically produced product. I think it is much more practical than a 12-person one. Let's blow away the stress of washing dishes~~~:)

Made in Korea (식세기 중 유일)  추가 설치 해도 되고 안 해도 되는: 콘센트가 멀어서 고민하다 싱크대 아래 콘센트에 연결하기로 결정 후 추가금 38,000 결제함(심미적인 부분에 투자하느냐만 선택하면 됨) 멀티탭으로 연결하거나 콘센트가 가까우면 추가 필요 없음. 싱크대 턱에 이미 타공 돼 있어서 배수호스 깔끔하게 연결함 단점: 아직은 없...  설치비는 무료!  카드할인 행사해서 좋은 가격으로 샀구요. 쿠팡은 매일 가격변동이 있고 그때그때 카드할인이나 와우할인 혜택이 생기니 지켜보시다가 가격 좋은 날 구매하시면 돼요. 저는 일요일 밤에 샀는데 월요일에 가격 오르다가 주말 쯤 다시 내리더라고요. 며칠 사이 이벤트가 달라지지만 가격차이가 그리 크진 않았고 하루라도 빨리 설치해서 노동에서 벗어나는 게 돈 버는 길인 듯 해요. 기사님도 친절하셨고 작업은 마무리 사인까지 한 시간 정도 걸렸어요.  6인용 살까말까 고민 중이시면 국낸 생산인 엘지 추천드려요. 저는 12인용보다 훨씬 실용적인 거 같아요. 설거지 스트레스 날려보아요~~~:)

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher Life 25 Years Recommended Items (This is a review of a product I bought with my own money) ] || ---------------- || I started with the LG 6-person dishwasher, then the LG 12-person No. 1, and the Samsung 12-person No. 2. LG was very satisfactory, but I was dissatisfied with the Samsung in terms of cleaning power and durability. So when I moved, I thought I had to go with LG. I couldn't install a 12-person model, so I decided on a countertop 6-person model. I was worried that it would be too small for a family of 3, but it's actually more comfortable, so I highly recommend it :) Advantages 1. Intuitive door opening button. Most models open by bending your wrist, but it's easier on your wrist and more comfortable to open up and down by lightly pressing the button with your finger. 2. Efficient in narrow spaces and not small in any way. It doesn't take up as much space as you'd think, and it has a two-tier tray, so you can put things on top, and you can put tall pots, etc. without removing the upper tray. 3. Stainless steel dish rack. The inner dish rack is made of stainless steel, not plastic silicone coating, so it's luxurious and safe (I liked it the most because the coating sometimes peeled off and rusted). 4. Dual cleaning wings. Two cleaning wings underneath clean evenly. 5. High-temperature water washing, hot air drying, UV sterilization function. It dries in hot air at 80 degrees Celsius, and additionally It also has a sterilizing function, so it's good until it's hot and crispy. It's easy to sterilize and disinfect cutting boards and knives. 6. It's perfect for those who are lazy because you can just drop a spoonful into the concave part of the detergent compartment door. (When using the ** frog, it was cumbersome to cut and the unique smell was hard for a dog person like me, so I settled on the unscented Nelly (powder type), but I recommend Nelly because it leaves almost no stains and has good ingredients. You only need to use a small amount.) 7. After drying the CD with hot air, the CD (Cool Dry) internal ventilation operates. You can stop it with the stop button in the middle and open the door to dry naturally. There is no automatic door opening function, but it seems that there is no problem with the internal drying because of this function. 8. It saves movement, and you can organize dishes right away by opening the sink storage cabinet. 9. It protects your back because you don't have to bend over^^ 10. Made in Korea (the only dishwasher) Additional installation is possible or not: I was worried because the outlet was far away, so I decided to connect it to the outlet under the sink and paid an additional fee of 38,000 (you just have to choose whether to invest in the aesthetic part). If you connect it to a multi-tap or the outlet is close, you don't need to add anything. The sink ledge is already perforated, so you can connect the drain hose neatly. Disadvantages: None yet. Installation fee is free! I bought it at a good price because there was a card discount event. Coupang's prices change every day, and there are card discounts or Wow discount benefits at that time, so you can watch and buy it on a good day. I bought it on Sunday night, and the price went up on Monday and then went down again around the weekend. The event changes in a few days, but the price difference is not that big, and it seems that the way to make money is to install it as soon as possible and get rid of labor. The technician was kind and the work took about an hour to complete. If you are thinking about buying a 6-person one, I recommend LG, which is a domestically produced product. I think it is much more practical than a 12-person one. Let's blow away the stress of washing dishes~~~:)
